records.Short Business Description: FactSet Research Systems Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a financial digital platform and enterprise solutions provider for the investment community.
records.Long Business Description:
FactSet Research Systems Inc., together with its subsidiaries (FactSet), operates as a global financial digital platform and enterprise solutions provider with open and flexible technologies that deliver financial intelligence to investment professionals.

The company’s platform delivers expansive data, sophisticated analytics, and flexible, artificial intelligence (AI)-powered technologies used by global financial professionals to power their critical investment workflows. As of August 31, 2025, the company had approximately 9,000 clients consists of over 237,000 investment professionals, including institutional asset managers, bankers, wealth managers, asset owners, partners, hedge funds, corporate users, and private equity and venture capital professionals. The company’s revenues are primarily derived from subscriptions to its multi-asset class data and solutions powered by its connected data and technology platform. The company’s products and services include workstations, portfolio analytics, and enterprise data solutions. The company also offers managed services that operate as an extension of its clients' internal teams to support data, performance, risk, and reporting workflows.

The company drives its business based on a detailed understanding of its clients’ workflows, which helps it to solve their most complex challenges. The company provides financial data and market intelligence on securities, companies, industries, and people to enable its clients to research investment ideas and analyze, monitor, and manage their portfolios. The company’s solutions span the investment lifecycle of investment research, portfolio construction and analysis, trade execution, performance measurement, risk management, and reporting. The company provides open and flexible technology offerings, including a configurable desktop and mobile platform, comprehensive data feeds, cloud-based digital solutions, and application programming interfaces (APIs). AI is embedded across these offerings to enhance data discovery, automate routine workflows, and improve the speed and accuracy of client insights. The CUSIP Global Services (CGS) business supports security master files relied on by the investment industry for critical front, middle, and back-office functions. All of the company’s platforms and solutions are supported by its dedicated client service team.

The company operates its business through three reportable segments: the Americas, EMEA, and Asia Pacific. Within each segment, the company offers data, products, and analytical applications by firm type: Institutional Buyside, Dealmakers, Wealth, and Partnerships, as well as CGS.

Americas: The Americas segment primarily sells to clients in North, Central, and South America. In the Americas, the company has offices in nine states in the United States (U.S.), including its corporate headquarters located in Norwalk, Connecticut. Additionally, the company has data centers in two states in the U.S. and an office in each of Brazil and Canada. Revenues from the Americas represented 65% of total revenues during fiscal 2025.

EMEA: The EMEA segment primarily sells to clients in Europe, the Middle East, and Africa via offices in Bulgaria, England, France, Germany, Italy, Latvia, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Sweden, and the United Arab Emirates. Revenues from EMEA represented 25% of total revenues during fiscal 2025.

Asia Pacific: The Asia Pacific segment primarily sells to clients in Asia and Australasia via office locations in Australia, China, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (SAR) of China, India, Japan, the Philippines, and Singapore. Revenues from Asia Pacific represented 10% of total revenues during fiscal 2025.

Firm Types

Institutional Buyside

Institutional Buyside focuses on multi-asset class solutions, including AI-powered workflows and insights, for global asset managers, asset owners, and hedge fund professionals across the investment portfolio lifecycle. This firm type includes workflows for research analysts, portfolio managers, and traders in the front office, as well as performance analysts, risk managers, and client service and marketing professionals in the middle office. The company’s front office on-platform solutions are designed for research management, order management, portfolio construction, and trade execution capabilities. The company’s middle office on-platform solutions are designed for performance measurement, attribution, reporting, and risk management capabilities, and are complemented by its middle office managed services. In addition to its on-platform workstation offerings, the company offers comprehensive off-platform data and technology solutions, including data feeds, APIs, and programmatic access for clients to engage with it in the environment best suited to them.

Dealmakers

Dealmakers focus on workflow solutions for investment bankers, sell-side research analysts, corporate users, investor relations officers, and private equity and venture capital professionals. The company provides comprehensive solutions to its clients, including workstations, mobile solutions, data feeds, APIs, proprietary and third-party data, and productivity tools for Microsoft Office. The company also delivers firm type tailored solutions for client relationship management (CRM) and AI-powered solutions to bring automation to time-consuming and manual aspects of its clients’ daily workflows. The company’s tools are used to analyze companies and markets, perform fundamental research, generate ideas, build and distribute presentations, and monitor investments. The company offers global coverage of public and private markets, granular industry metrics, deep history, and transparency through proprietary and third-party sourced databases.

Wealth

Wealth focuses on comprehensive solutions for wealth management clients, including its web-based workstation, book-of-business dashboards for advisors, data feeds, APIs, proprietary and third-party data, and productivity tools for Microsoft Office. The company also offers AI-powered prospecting, monitoring, and proposal generation tools that enable financial advisors to grow and enhance existing client relationships. The company’s Wealth solution enables its clients to easily integrate its products into their CRM software and internally developed applications. Wealth clients use the company’s advisory tools to provide support for their businesses, including home office, advisory, and client engagement work. The company continues to focus on expanding its relevant data offerings and increasing workflow efficiency across the investment portfolio lifecycle for wealth management firms.

Partnerships and CGS

Partnerships delivers solutions such as data and technology solutions, workstations, and digital or analytics solutions to firms in the financial services ecosystem, including data, analytics, and technology platform providers. This includes curated datasets and turnkey APIs to enable technologists and developers to power new AI-based workflows with programmatic access to FactSet’s high-quality, connected content. CGS is the exclusive issuer of CUSIP and CINS identifiers globally. CGS also acts as the official numbering agency for International Securities Identification Number (ISIN) identifiers in the U.S. and as a substitute ISIN agency for more than 30 other countries.

Business Strategy

The company strives to be a trusted enterprise partner and service provider to its clients across the financial services spectrum, delivering relevant intelligence, insights, and execution solutions tailored to its clients’ business models.

The company is focused on growing its global business through three strategically aligned geographic segments: the Americas, EMEA, and Asia Pacific. This approach allows the company to better manage resources, target solutions, and interact with its clients effectively.

records.Short Business Description: Fang Holdings Limited operates a real estate Internet portal in the People’s Republic of China.
records.Long Business Description:
Fang Holdings Limited operates as a real estate Internet portal.

The company’s user-friendly websites and mobile apps support active online communities and networks of users seeking information on, and services for, the real estate and home-related sectors in China.

Services

The company provides marketing services, listing services, leads generation services, financial services, and other services to participants in the PRC real estate and home-related sectors primarily through its websites and its mobile apps.

Marketing Services

The company targets its marketing services toward participants in China’s real estate and home-related sectors. Marketing is one of the company’s important businesses. The company’s marketing services are delivered through its website www.fang.com and its mobile apps, which can be downloaded for both iOS-, and Android-based operating systems, and include traditional Internet advertisements such as banners, links, logos, and floating signs, as well as featured promotions, which are specially-tailored packages of traditional online advertising tools.

Customers of its marketing services include a range of participants in the PRC real estate and home-related sectors, such as real estate developers, real estate professionals, such as agents and brokers, retailers, and other suppliers of home furnishing and improvement products and services, and home design, decoration, and re-modeling companies.

The company also combines traditional online advertising tools with new marketing strategies to create featured promotion packages for its customers. Using the inherent flexibility of website advertising, the company creates customized marketing and promotional packages with additional features at the request of its customers to meet the different needs of various customers operating in diverse geographic markets in China.

The company generally enters into two main types of marketing contracts with its customers. The first type is a framework contract prescribing the total payment amount and price of products. The second type is an order contract with payment due within 90 days of the execution of the contract. The company’s marketing framework contracts generally have a one-year term.

Listing Services

Real estate agents, brokers, managers, developers, owners, and suppliers of home furnishing and improvement products and services subscribe to the company’s basic listing services for a fee, which allow them to post listings for properties or home furnishing and improvement products and services over the subscription periods. All visitors to the company’s websites and mobile apps have access to listing information free of charge.

Most of the company’s basic listing subscription contracts are one to three months in duration. The company typically collects payments for such subscriptions for its basic listing services before the signing of a subscription contract. The company also offers longer arrangements, such as to certain large real estate agencies. For subscription contracts with longer terms, the contract prices are generally payable in installments every one to three months until the end of the contract term.

The company offers free trials of its basic listing services. These free trials allow users to experience its basic listing services and high user traffic.

In addition, the company allows individual property owners to list their own properties for sale or rent on its property listing sections without charge. Such free listings do not enjoy prime positioning, and are strictly limited to individual, non-real estate professional home owners. To help prevent real estate professionals from abusing the individual property owner basic listing service, the company has created a customer hotline for its users to report any abuse.

The company’s basic listing services help it build its comprehensive database of information regarding new, secondary, and rental properties, as well as home furnishing and improvement products and services in major urban centers across China.

The company updates the listing data on its websites and mobile apps on a daily basis through its proprietary content management process and software. This proprietary content management process is monitored by the company’s listing monitoring team, and allows its customers to submit listing information in a specific format. The company’s listing monitoring team periodically checks all listing information uploaded to its websites and mobile apps to identify common anomalies in posted information in order to limit unreliable data.

Leads Generation Services

The company launched its leads generation services in late 2017 and began to recognize revenue in 2018.

The company provides leads generation services to real estate developers, real estate brokers, and, to a lesser extent, suppliers of home furnishing and improvement-related products and services by connecting its customers with scattered demand for real estate and home furnishing and improvement-related services. The company charges the service fee based on the number of sales leads it delivered during a certain period of time. The company recognizes revenues upon its delivery of the sales leads to its customers.

Financial Services

The company primarily provides secured consumer loans to individuals that meet its credit assessment requirements. The company generally charges borrowers both interest and service fees. The company assesses each individual loan receivable for impairment on a quarterly basis. As part of its impairment assessment, the company considers the timeliness of collection to date, changes in the value of collateral provided by the borrowers, and expected default rates. The company obtained approvals to engage in the microfinancing business from government authorities of three cities, including Beihai (the obtained approval for which was transferred to Nanning in 2021), Shanghai, and Chongqing.

Other Services

In addition to its core offerings of listing, marketing, and financial services, the company also grants licenses to certain local agencies, allowing them to use its brand and backend systems for real estate marketing. These licensing agreements enable the agencies to leverage the company’s established platform and tools, while generating additional revenue for it through the associated fees and services.

Websites

The company’s principal website, www.fang.com, is the leading real estate Internet portal, and one of the leading home furnishing and improvement websites in China in terms of visitor traffic. As part of the company’s effort to promote its brand recognition, it changed the address of its principal website from www.soufun.com to www.fang.com in July 2014. Fang means home in Chinese.

As of December 31, 2024, the company’s www.fang.com website contained contents covering 658 cities across China, as well as Hong Kong, Singapore, United States, Canada, and Australia.

The company’s www.fang.com website covers a wide spectrum of PRC real estate, and home furnishing and improvement, and other home-related information, and constitutes the foundation and gateway for its primary business activities.

Online Property Listings and Search Engines for New Home, and Secondary, and Rental Properties

The company’s www.fang.com website contains databases for new home, secondary, and rental properties, and provides search engines on such properties in its databases.

With its on-the-ground capabilities in approximately 43 offices in China, the company devotes significant resources to collect first-hand real estate market intelligence and listing information in such markets, and to update such information on a regular basis. The company’s user-friendly search engines and website interfaces allow users to tailor their searches to specific types of properties by using search criteria. records.Short Business Description: Fangdd Network Group Ltd., an investment holding company, provides real estate information services through online platform in the People’s Republic of China.
records.Long Business Description:
Fangdd Network Group Ltd., a customer-oriented PropTech company based in China, focuses on providing real estate transaction digitalization services.

The company operates a real estate-focused online marketplace for real estate transactions and related services in China. The company’s marketplace connects real estate sellers, agents, buyers, and other participants as part of a vibrant ecosystem and a self-reinforcing network, enabling marketplace participants to transact real estate assets with efficiency at lowered costs. The company provides all participants with one-stop digital real estate transaction services and a seamless transaction experience through its reliable and extensive property listings, SaaS solutions, intelligent matching algorithms, and other real estate related services.

The company provides agencies and agents with innovative products and SaaS solutions to improve the way they conduct business and manage their day-to-day operations, making them increasingly reliant on its tools and services. This enables the company to build a huge agent network, thereby accumulating the service resources of real estate transactions on its marketplace. By providing real estate sellers with innovative and diversified digital marketing solutions, as well as access to the company’s extensive agent network, the company helps real estate sellers move their traditional offline business online and improve transaction efficiency, thereby gathering the property resources of real estate transactions on its marketplace. In addition, the company continues to attract real estate buyers and other participants to its marketplace by leveraging the property and asset resources, and related services it has, and continually improves the efficiency of transactions and service abilities on its marketplace with unique market insights, underpinned by its proprietary artificial intelligence, algorithms, and data.

Online Marketplace

The company builds an open online marketplace for real estate transactions and related services. The company’s marketplace connects real estate sellers, agents, buyers, and other participants as part of a vibrant ecosystem and a self-reinforcing network. The company provides all participants with one-stop digital real estate transaction services and a seamless transaction experience through its reliable and extensive property listings, SaaS solutions, intelligent matching algorithms, and other real estate related services.

The foundation of the company’s marketplace is transaction digitalization. Through the company’s diversified SaaS products and solutions, it helps real estate sellers and agents identify effective sales leads and potential home buyers, achieve efficient online interactions, and improve marketing efficiency, while providing superior customer experience and better quality at lower customer acquisition costs. By building the rules and tools required for transactions, the company moves the components of real estate transactions online, including, among other things, communication, commission settlement. Based on the rich data generated by the company’s marketplace, and its big data analysis capabilities, the company improves the transparency and efficiency of real estate transactions on its marketplace by, among others, monitoring transactions on the marketplace, matching property listings to the most suitable agents, recommending agents to real estate developers, and filtering out inaccurate property information. The company provides all marketplace participants with basic management systems and tools for online operations, encompassing SaaS solutions for agents, real estate sellers, and real estate buyers, respectively, as well as other real estate related services for other participants, such as asset management services, to name a few.

The company’s marketplace is driven by the following core attributes:

Technological Expertise: The company has built a real-time data warehouse, utilizing data analysis and cloud computing to provide visualized data services. The company provides targeted recommendations to marketplace participants through artificial intelligence algorithms. The company also offers customized products to all participants in the real estate industry, enabling them to boost operational efficiency.

A Strong and Trustworthy Brand: The company has been deeply involved in the real estate industry for over a decade, during which it has developed favorable brand recognition. As real estate sellers in China tend to partner with companies with a long operating history, extensive agent resources, and diversified product and service offerings, the company gains competitive advantages in attracting real estate sellers to post listings on its marketplace. As such, the company’s brand name, as well as product and service capabilities, facilitate effective online transactions.

Amicable Relationship Among Platform Participants: All participants on the company’s marketplace are indispensable in successful real estate transactions. As an online marketplace that facilitates these transactions, the company understands the importance of building and maintaining amicable relationships among all marketplace participants, especially real estate buyers and agents, which contributes to the company’s ability to obtain sufficient property resources and service resources, and grow its business.

Profound Industry Insights: With the company’s focus on China’s real estate industry, it draws on its extensive knowledge of this industry, in-depth understanding of real estate transaction services and digital operations, and profound insights into industry trends. The company is therefore well-positioned to provide value-added services and products, catering to the diverse and ever-changing needs of marketplace participants, and seize market opportunities.

Real Estate Sellers

records.Short Business Description: Fintech Select Ltd. provides financial payment services in Canada.
records.Long Business Description:
Fintech Select Ltd. is a Canadian company specializing in the distribution of prepaid wireless airtime, call center operations, and financial services that offer prepaid debit card solutions. The company operates mainly within Canada, progressively expanding its footprint in the financial technology sector, focusing on enhancing customer engagement and operational efficiency.

Business Segments

The company operates through Distribution Division, Call Center, and Financial Services Division segments.

The Distribution Division primarily focuses on selling prepaid wireless airtime. This segment provides customers with convenient access to mobile services, catering to a diverse clientele seeking flexible and accessible communication solutions. The enhancement of distribution channels and partnerships has been pivotal in maximizing the reach of these products.

The Call Center segment addresses customer service and inquiries related to the company's product offerings. Through operational excellence and a commitment to customer satisfaction, this segment plays a crucial role in overall service delivery, ensuring that clients receive comprehensive support and solutions tailored to their needs. 

The Financial Services Division contributes to the company's portfolio through its provision of prepaid debit card services. This segment is immensely valuable, providing customers with secure and efficient means of managing their finances. The company is committed to evolving this segment by integrating advanced technologies, thus enhancing transaction security and user experience.

Business Strategy

The company adopts a multifaceted business strategy aimed at sustaining competitive advantages while refining its operational models. The company's strategy leverages innovation, strong customer relationships, and efficient market penetration channels. The company is dedicated to enhancing its product offerings and integrating cutting-edge technology to improve service delivery across various customer touchpoints. 

Products and Services

The company offers a diverse array of products and services tailored to meet the needs of its customer base. The company's flagship product in the Distribution Division is prepaid wireless airtime. This service allows customers flexible access to telecommunications without the burden of traditional contracts. 

Within the Financial Services Division, the company provides prepaid debit cards that facilitate secure transactions and personal finance management. This service is particularly relevant for users seeking accessible banking solutions without the complexities associated with conventional banking systems.

The Call Center segment ensures that customers receive top-tier service and support, enhancing overall satisfaction. The company continuously focuses on training its call center staff to handle inquiries efficiently and deliver exemplary customer care.

In all divisions, the company prioritizes utility and customer experience, evolving its offerings based on feedback and changing market dynamics. As the financial technology landscape advances, the company remains committed to updating and improving its products to meet customer expectations.

Geographical Markets Served

The company primarily operates within Canada. While the company's services have the potential to reach international markets, its operations and customer base are currently concentrated in the Canadian market. The geographical focus allows for tailored marketing strategies and customer engagement initiatives that resonate more deeply with local consumers. 

Seasonality

The company experiences some variability in its business operations throughout the year, which may correlate with market demands and consumer behaviors. The nature of prepaid services often sees fluctuations based on consumer spending habits, seasonal promotions, and economic factors that influence disposable income. The company employs various marketing strategies to mitigate seasonality effects and sustain customer engagement year-round.

Customers

The company serves a broad customer base across various categories. These segments include individual consumers utilizing prepaid mobile services and debit cards, businesses seeking robust customer service through call center solutions, and partners interested in distributing prepaid products. By developing tailored solutions for each category, the company ensures a broad and adaptable customer strategy.

Sales and Marketing

The company employs a variety of sales and marketing strategies to reach its target audience effectively. Marketing initiatives encompass digital marketing, partnerships with retail outlets, and direct sales through its call center operations. The multi-channel distribution strategy ensures that customers can access products and services through their preferred means, enhancing overall convenience and customer satisfaction.

History

The company was founded in 1999. The company was formerly known as Selectcore Ltd. and changed its name to Fintech Select Ltd. in August 2017.

records.Long Business Description:
Focus Technology Co., Ltd. operates e-commerce platforms.

Business Segments

The company operates through several key segments, each designed to address specific needs within the international trade ecosystem and to provide comprehensive solutions for both suppliers and buyers.

B2B E-commerce Platform (China Manufacturing Network)

This segment operates China Manufacturing Network, a full-chain B2B e-commerce platform that integrates product display, intelligent search, transaction facilitation, logistics, payment, and after-sales services.

AI and Intelligent Applications

This segment invests heavily in the research and development of artificial intelligence technologies, with a focus on building AI large models tailored for the B2B e-commerce sector. The company’s AI applications include intelligent search and recommendation, automated customer service, risk assessment, and market analysis.

Digital Trade Services

This segment provides a comprehensive suite of digital trade services, including product information management, transaction facilitation, logistics coordination, payment processing, and after-sales support. The company offers customized solutions for different types of enterprises, including factories, trading companies, and service providers, helping them to optimize their operations and expand their global reach.

Data Center and IT Infrastructure

This segment operates state-of-the-art data centers that support its digital platforms and services. The company’s data centers are designed with energy efficiency and environmental sustainability in mind, utilizing advanced cooling systems, high-efficiency IT equipment, and intelligent energy management systems. The company’s IT infrastructure includes a distributed search platform, a large-scale website security protection system, and a container application PaaS platform.

The company operates several subsidiaries, including New One Station Insurance Agency Co., Ltd., InQbrands Inc. in the United States, and Doba, Inc., which operates Doba.com.

Business Strategy

The company’s business strategy is centered on innovation-driven growth, customer-centric service, and the continuous enhancement of its core competitiveness through technological advancement and business model innovation.

The company’s primary strategic focus is on deepening market expansion and consolidating its global business footprint. The company is actively exploring new and emerging markets, such as Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Africa, which offer significant growth potential and diverse market opportunities. The company is investing in market research, resource allocation, and the development of region-specific market entry strategies to capture new business opportunities and support the internationalization of Chinese suppliers.

At the same time, the company is committed to strengthening its position in traditional markets, including Europe and the Americas, which remain critical to its overall business portfolio. The company is enhancing its understanding of local buyer needs and preferences, optimizing its product and service offerings, and building stronger relationships with key buyers and partners.

Products and Services

The company offers a comprehensive range of products and services designed to support the digital transformation and internationalization of Chinese manufacturing enterprises and to facilitate efficient, secure, and intelligent cross-border trade.

China Manufacturing Network Platform: The company’s flagship product is the China Manufacturing Network, a full-chain B2B e-commerce platform that connects Chinese suppliers with global buyers. The platform provides a wide array of features, including product display, intelligent search and recommendation, secure transaction systems, logistics coordination, payment processing, and after-sales support.

AI-Powered Solutions: The company is developing and deploying AI large models specifically tailored for the B2B e-commerce sector. These models are used to enhance the quality of platform content, optimize operational processes, and improve SEO performance. The company is also exploring the integration of multi-modal technologies, such as text, image, audio, and video data, to further enhance the intelligence and user experience of its platform.

Digital Trade Services: The company provides end-to-end digital trade services, including product information management, transaction facilitation, logistics coordination, payment processing, and after-sales support.

Data Center and IT Infrastructure Services: The company operates advanced data centers that support its digital platforms and services.

Geographical Markets

The company serves a global customer base, with a strong presence in both traditional and emerging markets. The company’s primary markets include Europe and the Americas, which have long been key business regions for the company. The company is also actively expanding into emerging markets such as Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Africa, which offer significant growth potential and diverse market opportunities. The company’s international expansion strategy involves in-depth market research, resource allocation, and the development of region-specific market entry strategies.

Customers

The company serves a diverse customer base that includes Chinese manufacturing enterprises, international buyers, trading companies, and service providers. The company’s primary customers are Chinese suppliers seeking to expand their global reach and international buyers looking for reliable suppliers and high-quality products from China.

The company’s platform, China Manufacturing Network, is designed to accommodate the needs of different types of enterprises, from large factories to small and medium-sized trading companies. The company provides customized solutions, professional training, and value-added services to enhance user experience and satisfaction. The company’s customer base is global, with users from Europe, the Americas, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Africa, and other regions.

Trade Names

The company operates under the trade name Focus Technology Co., Ltd. and its flagship platform, China Manufacturing Network.

Sales and Marketing

The company’s sales and marketing strategy is based on a combination of digital marketing, data-driven customer targeting, and professional training for sales personnel. The company leverages big data analytics to identify and target potential customers, predict customer needs and purchasing behavior, and develop personalized sales strategies.

The company utilizes social media platforms to expand its sales channels, build personal brands and professional images for sales personnel, and engage with potential customers. The company encourages sales personnel to interact with customers on social media, share valuable industry information, product cases, and promotional activities, and organize industry exchange events to enhance customer loyalty and satisfaction.

The company’s marketing activities are supported by a professional market research team and advanced data analytics tools, enabling it to optimize resource allocation, improve the effectiveness of marketing campaigns, and maximize the return on marketing investment.

Environmental Laws

The company strictly adheres to the requirements of the People’s Republic of China’s Environmental Protection Law, Water Pollution Prevention Law, Air Pollution Prevention Law, Environmental Noise Pollution Prevention Law, and Solid Waste Pollution Prevention Law.

History

Focus Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1996.

records.Short Business Description: Fold Holdings, Inc., a bitcoin financial services company, provides access to bitcoin through a suite of consumer financial products in the United States.
records.Long Business Description:
Fold Holdings, Inc. (Fold) is a pioneering bitcoin financial services company dedicated to expanding access to bitcoin through a comprehensive suite of consumer financial products.

Fold offers consumers an FDIC insured checking account, a Visa prepaid debit card, bill payments, and an extensive catalog of merchant reward offers. Fold also partners with third-party service providers that offer bitcoin exchange and custody services. By integrating bitcoin across traditional financial services, Fold aims to serve as a key point of entry for consumers to engage with and integrate bitcoin into their everyday lives.

In addition to enabling customers to accumulate bitcoin through its rewards program, the company itself actively invests in and accumulates bitcoin for its treasury. Bitcoin is a superior asset to hold, offering long-term value preservation and growth potential compared to traditional fiat currencies or other investment vehicles. This strategic allocation underscores the company’s commitment to maximizing stockholder value and positioning Fold at the forefront of the emerging bitcoin economy.

Fold products and services are available in the United States through the Fold mobile app.

Products and Services

Fold is among the leading gateways to earning, buying, and living on bitcoin. The company offers its customers a comprehensive suite of financial service products tailored to meet the needs of the company’s customers seeking to integrate bitcoin into their everyday finances.

Banking and Payments

Fold offers a free FDIC-insured checking account that supports direct deposits, bill payments, and the ability to receive paychecks up to three days early. Fold is not a FDIC insured bank, and the FDIC-insured checking accounts are offered through Sutton Bank. In 2020, Fold partnered with Visa to launch a bitcoin rewards debit card, the Fold Visa Prepaid Card (the ‘Fold Card’). The Fold Card is a prepaid debit card linked directly to a customer’s Fold checking account. Customers can order a Fold Card for free and use it anywhere Visa is accepted to make purchases, pay bills, and earn bitcoin rewards.

Rewards Network

The company offers bitcoin rewards to its users through the Fold Rewards Program. This program allows the company’s users to earn promotional credits (‘rewards’) denominated in bitcoin by engaging in various qualifying actions. For purchases made with the Fold Card, customers can earn up to 1.5% back on rotating spending categories, mortgage, rent, and bills, as well as up to 15% or more on card-linked merchant offers. In addition to Fold Card rewards, customers can earn up to 20% back in rewards through the company’s expansive catalog of merchant offers at top merchants. Fold’s expansive rewards network includes top offer aggregators and direct merchant relationships to maximize inventory and exclusive rewards. Customers can also earn rewards for other types of behaviors, such as referral bonuses, sign-up bonuses, spinning a daily rewards wheel, and other behavioral actions that the company chooses to incentivize. Both the amount of rewards earned and the qualifying actions that are eligible to earn rewards change from time to time at Fold’s discretion.

All rewards are earned immediately upon the performance of a qualifying action by the user, but not all rewards are immediately available for redemption. The redemption criteria for rewards varies by the type of qualifying action or transaction as outlined in the terms and conditions of the Fold Rewards Program. For example, rewards earned on the daily spin wheel are available for redemption immediately, while rewards earned via certain qualifying spend transactions on the Fold Card are subject to a 30-day settlement period before becoming available for redemption, a policy that is in place to prevent fraudulent activities.

Per the terms and conditions of the Fold Rewards Program, rewards are subject to adjustment for chargebacks, returns, refunds, or other circumstances. In addition, rewards are subject to expiry if users fail to maintain an active account for more than twelve consecutive months.

A user may redeem rewards by making a request to withdraw them to a personal bitcoin wallet, either to an external bitcoin wallet or to a user’s bitcoin wallet at the qualified custodians used by Fold. Users can initiate a redemption request at any time, but redemption requests are fulfilled by Fold approximately once per week as a batch fulfilment. To fulfill rewards withdrawal requests Fold sends bitcoin from the company’s Rewards Treasury to the user’s bitcoin wallet address, which they provide during their redemption request. In the future, Fold may offer the ability for users to redeem their rewards for other goods and services but has no immediate plans to do so.

Customer rewards are valued in bitcoin as of the date the rewards are earned, and therefore the company tries to match the cost basis of those rewards with the cost basis of the company’s Rewards Treasury. To do so, Fold typically purchases bitcoin once per day in an amount that approximates the amount of rewards earned by customers on that day. The company’s intention is to always maintain an amount of bitcoin in the company’s Rewards Treasury equal to or greater than the company’s customer rewards obligations. The company monitors the balances of its Rewards Treasury and customer rewards obligations on a daily basis to ensure that the company has appropriate reserves to fulfill customer obligations. In the event that the balance of the company’s Rewards Treasury were to fall below the balance of the company’s corresponding customer rewards liability, Fold may utilize excess bitcoin reserves from the company’s Investment Treasury to fulfill customer liabilities. Fold purchases bitcoin for the company’s Investment Treasury on an intermittent basis when the company has available discretionary cash balances to do so.

Custody & Trading

Fold partners with Fortress Trust LLC, a Nevada-chartered trust company (‘Fortress’), and BitGo Trust Company, Inc., a South Dakota-chartered trust company (‘BitGo’) (collectively, the ‘Bitcoin Service Providers’), to offer eligible customers the ability to buy, sell, store, and withdraw Bitcoin through Fold. These Bitcoin Service Providers are both qualified custodians, meaning they are qualified under applicable state banking, payments or trust laws to custody digital assets, that offer institutional-grade custody, liquidity, and security solutions for digital assets, specializing in multi-signature wallets and cold storage services for bitcoin. Additional information with respect to the Bitcoin Service Providers’ respective qualifications under applicable law can be found online at https://fortresstrust.com/licenses, with respect to Fortress, and https://www.bitgo.com/company/licenses, with respect to BitGo. Fold does not directly hold or control any of its customers’ digital assets.

Fold utilizes both Fortress and BitGo for the purpose of providing operational redundancy in the event of technical or regulatory limitations at one or the other. In addition, certain states are supported by only one of the two Bitcoin Service Providers, and those states can change from time to time based on the licensing status of each provider.

To access Custody & Trading products, Fold’s customers are first onboarded to the Fold app through the normal onboarding process, which includes Know Your Customer (‘KYC’) checks by Fold. Customers are then onboarded to either BitGo or Fortress based on the state they live in. Customers also undergo KYC checks by the Bitcoin Service Provider to which they are onboarded, and they are required to accept the terms and conditions of the Bitcoin Service Provider to which they are onboarded.

records.Short Business Description: Friendable, Inc., a mobile-focused technology and marketing company, connects and engages users through applications.
records.Long Business Description:
Friendable, Inc. operates as a mobile-focused technology and marketing company, connecting and engaging users through two distinctly branded applications.

The company initially released its flagship product Friendable, as a social application where users can create one-on-one or group-style meetups. In 2019, the company moved the Friendable app closer to a traditional dating application with its focus on building revenue, as well as reintroducing the brand as a non-threatening, all-inclusive place where ‘Everything starts with Friendship’…meet, chat & date.

On June 28, 2017, the company formed a wholly owned Nevada subsidiary called Fan Pass, Inc.

Fan Pass is the company’s most recent app/brand, released on July 24, 2020. Fan Pass believes in connecting Fans of their favorite celebrity or artist, to an exclusive VIP or Backstage experience, right from their smartphone or other connected devices. Fan Pass allows an artist’s fanbase to experience something they would otherwise never have the opportunity to afford or geographically attend. The company aims to establish Fan Pass as its premier brand and mobile platform that is dedicated to engaging music fans from anywhere around the World with the music artists featured on the FanPassLive App. The company developed an enhanced version of its Fan Pass application (v2.0) with improved features and attributes, which it released on July 24, 2021. This upgrade includes all new UI/UX attributes, upgraded feature sets for artists and fans, an accelerated artist on boarding process and enhanced dashboard features.

On August 5, 2021, the company announced the approval of the Fan Pass v2.0 livestream artist platform by both the Apple App and Google Play Stores. The mobile applications can be downloaded by users worldwide, and Fan Pass v2.0 is also accessible via desktop and web applications. FanPassLive offers artists at all levels and genres, the opportunity to engage fans from one platform, removing the need for multiple sharing platforms. It conveniently provides Exclusive Artist ‘Channels’ jam-packed with all their relevant content from videos, photos, interviews, and past and upcoming events. While it’s free for music artists to join, Fan Pass monetizes its business model by using an ‘ALL ACCESS VIP’ Offering to music fans priced at a $2.99 monthly subscription ($25.99 annual subscription) with a three-day free trial. Fan Pass also offers an ‘Artist Pro’ monthly subscription of $8.99, which offers the ‘ALL ACCESS VIP’, plus advanced dashboard analytics, merchandising store access and promotion of scheduled music events.

On January 5, 2022, the company acquired the intellectual property assets, customer lists, websites and supporting computer programs associated with the music services business of Artist Republik, Inc. Artist Republik is an innovative, decentralized music business that allows independent music artists from around the world to take more control of their own careers through networking, centralized resources, and AI-based management tools. The acquisition is aimed to solidify the company’s now all-encompassing suite of products and music services, positioning the company as an all-inclusive music offering to both music fans and music artists. With a suite of artist-centric services that extend livestreaming capabilities and virtual performance options, this powerful combination of support and services offered by Fan Pass and Artist Republik will now include music distribution for all artists, while fans can enjoy access to a variety of artist channels across different genres, exclusive live events, behind-the-scenes content, artist merchandising and more. The offering also provides artists more autonomy and freedom over their own music, ticketing streams, blog/social promotion, custom merchandise development, beats/samples sales and more, all without being signed to a record label or giving up their creative rights.

In January 2022, the company also launched and released FeaturedX.com, a web property acquired as part of the company’s acquisition of Artist Republik, FeaturedX has thousands of music artists currently available and is a place where artists can book a guest feature, co-write, MIDI composition or live instrumental tracking for other artists releasing their next single or looking to extend reach and exposure by tapping into these available resources for music production and collaboration.

Competition

The company competes against many companies to attract and engage users, including companies, which have greater financial resources and substantially larger user bases, such as eHarmony, Match.com, and others, which offer a variety of Internet and mobile device-based products, services and content.

History

The company was founded in 2007. It was incorporated in 2007. The company was formerly known as iHookup Social, Inc. and changed its name to Friendable, Inc. in 2015.

records.Long Business Description:
FRNT Financial Inc. a financial technology company that provides a capital markets trading platform for institutional investors to access alternative trading opportunities.

Business Segments

The company operates in a single business segment, focusing on developing its capital market trading platform for institutional investors. The company seeks to create an innovative trading environment that connects investors with alternative market opportunities, enabling swift responses to market demands.

Revenue analysis indicates that a portion of the company's income is derived from domestic clients in Canada, while a significant majority comes from international clients, with notable contributions from markets, such as the Cayman Islands and the United Kingdom.

Business Strategy

The company's business strategy seeks to establish leadership in the financial technology sector through continuous innovation of its trading platform. It provides tailored solutions to meet the specific needs of institutional investors, emphasizing fast execution, comprehensive market data, and efficient analytics that include.

Technology Development: Investing in R&D to reduce transaction costs and enhance operational efficiency.

Market Expansion: Targeting international markets to diversify revenue streams and growth opportunities.

Client Relationship Management: Strengthening relationships with existing clients while expanding the customer base to ensure satisfaction and loyalty.

Regulatory Compliance and Risk Management: Navigating complex regulatory landscapes to reduce operational risk and enhance credibility.

Revenue Diversification: The company Exploring additional services or products to increase revenue and decrease reliance on current sources.

Products and Services

The foremost product of the company is its capital market trading platform, which allows institutional clients to access a variety of trading opportunities. This robust platform facilitates various trading transactions and delivers essential functionalities, including real-time market data, advanced analytics, and trade execution services that streamline the trading process.

The services that the company provides revolve around advisory and consulting. Advisory services involve assisting clients in navigating complex trading strategies and identifying potential market opportunities. The emphasis is placed on delivering customized insights that align with investors' unique requirements, helping them maximize their trading effectiveness.

Consulting services seeks to support the operational management of trading for institutional investors. The company engages with clients to develop strategies that optimize trading activities while offering operational efficiencies. This two-pronged approach ensures that clients are equipped with both the tools and insights necessary to make informed trading decisions.

Moreover, the company actively seeks to develop strategic partnerships that can enhance the value proposition of its services. By aligning with other technology and financial service providers, the company can offer diversified services that create additional touchpoints for its clients.

Geographical Markets

The company generates its revenue from clients located in Canada and substantial international markets, indicating a diverse geographical footprint. A breakdown of revenue sources shows that the significant contributions come from the Cayman Islands and the United Kingdom. This geographical diversity assists the company in reducing risks associated with market fluctuations and economic uncertainties in any single region.

Seasonality

The trading sector typically exhibits a certain degree of seasonality, influenced by market trends, investor behavior, and economic cycles. The company is expected to encounter fluctuations in trading volumes and revenues throughout the fiscal year, potentially influenced by factors, such as varying market conditions, economic forecasts, and investor sentiment.

Customer

The company serves a diverse clientele primarily consisting of institutional investors. The data reveals that a small number of clients significantly influence overall revenue, with three major customers generating substantial portions of total revenues. This highlights the need for the company to foster strong relationships while continuously working to broaden its customer base to mitigate risks associated with high customer concentration.

Sales and Marketing

The company employs multiple modes of marketing and distribution channels to reach its target audience. Digital marketing strategies play a substantial role in enhancing visibility within the fintech market. Utilizing content marketing, search engine optimization, and targeted advertising campaigns enables the company to connect with potential institutional clients actively seeking capital market solutions.

History

FRNT Financial Inc. was founded in 2018. The company was incorporated in 2018.

records.Short Business Description: Fund.com Inc. provides fund management products and risk management solutions that help financial advisors, wealth managers, institutions, and ultra-high-net-worth families to create and manage wealth.
records.Long Business Description:
Fund.com Inc. provides fund management products and risk management solutions to financial advisors, wealth managers, institutions, and ultra-high-net-worth families create and manage wealth. The company also offers services and investment fund information to the mass-market individual investor over the Internet at www.fund.com.

Wealth Management Business Solutions

ETF Platform: This is an outsourced platform for launching actively managed exchange traded funds (ETFs) for banks, trust companies, independent wealth advisers, and investment managers who desire to issue and manage ETFs on a white-label basis.

Regulatory Authority: Outsourced administration and compliance for ETFs, including the use of specialized regulatory authority granted to the company by the Securities and Exchange Commission (the SEC) permitting the discretionary active management of assets within an ETF to meet the investment objectives of the ETF and ETF manager.

Investment Products: A wealth management business catering to institutional and ultra-high-net-worth clients seeking investment in hedge funds offering a family of hedge fund and fund of funds investment products.

Fund Distribution: This is a fund distribution business that sells and markets various fund products.

Online Lead Generation: A Web site accessible on the Internet through a domain name that is intended to engage individual investors as an online educational resource and then to match their investment needs with providers of retirement solutions and investment funds, including ETFs.

Operations

AdvisorShares Investments, LLC

Through its AdvisorShares Investments LLC subsidiary (AdvisorShares), the company has developed an investment platform that originates and sells a new investment product known as actively managed exchange traded funds (ETFs). AdvisorShares sells ETF products in conjunction with investment managers who are responsible for managing the assets within the ETFs that the company creates. The business of AdvisorShares is to develop a diverse range of ‘actively managed’ ETFs together with third party asset managers, and to list these ETFs on the New York Stock Exchange, or a similar national or international securities exchange. The target clients of AdvisorShares are third party investment advisors who already manage clients' assets, have a favorable track record and desire to package their investment strategy using exchange-traded funds.

Weston Capital Management, LLC

In March 2010, the company consummated the acquisition of 100% of the membership interests of Weston Capital Management, LLC (Weston Capital). Weston Capital has three lines of business: it originates and markets fund of funds; it originates and markets single-manager hedge funds; and it raises capital to seed new hedge funds. Weston Capital primarily manages and advises funds of hedge funds with a broad range of strategies, and fund platforms that ‘seed’ other funds or fund managers, including SEC-registered investment advisers. In 2010, Weston Capital and Harcourt AG formed a strategic alliance for investment manager identification and fund seeding.

Whyte Lyon Socratic, Inc.

In 2009, the company acquired 100% of the capital stock of Whyte Lyon Socratic Inc., doing business as ‘The Institute of Modern Economy’, a Delaware corporation (Whyte Lyon). Whyte Lyon is a development stage online provider of financial literacy video content delivered over the Internet. The remote educational content is designed to assist on-line students to: develop the necessary skills to understand financial transactions and financial markets; develop money management skills to help them manage their income and wealth; and reach particular goals, including homeownership, debt reconciliation, or improved credit reports.

The company delivers on-line educational content to designated end users for distribution and online streaming. Its content, to be designated and branded as ‘The Institute of Modern Economy’ would consist of 7 to 12 minute educational course segments on personal finance management, financial products, and other related financial topics. Under the trademarked name ‘Institute of Modern Economy’ (IOME), educational videos are shot, animated and produced for existing clientele. Customers may either customize specific subject matter for development, or purchase existing material from the IOME catalog.

Investment in Vensure Employer Services, Inc.

The company has an investment in the equity of Vensure Employer Services, Inc., an Arizona corporation (Vensure). Vensure is a professional employer organization (PEO). Vensure provides a range of services to small and medium-sized businesses, consisting of benefits and payroll administration, health and workers’ compensation insurance programs, personnel records management, employer liability management, employee recruiting and selection, employee performance management, employee training and development services and retirement obligations, including a retirement services product line that offers various options to clients like 401(k) plans, profit sharing, and money purchase plans. Vensure provides these services to small to medium-sized businesses.

Vensure also provides software development services primarily geared toward automating its clients’ business processes and integrating their systems with Vensure’s payroll and human resource management information system. Vensure owns a general insurance agency, Vensurance, LLC, which offers various property and casualty as well as life and health insurance products for businesses and associations.

The Fund.com Web site

The company also publishes information online about investment funds at www.fund.com. In March 2010, the company entered into a strategic alliance with Transparensee Systems, Inc., to develop a next generation search engine for the www.fund.com Web site to help investors find their best choices among mutual funds and ETFs. It is anticipated that investors would be able to search the database for mutual funds and ETFs in real time to find specific funds that meet their criteria.

Competition

The company's competitors include Barrett Business Services, Inc.; Diversified Human Resources, Inc.; Administaff, Inc.; and Paychex, Inc.

The company has various direct on-line competitors with long operating histories and brands, such as Thestreet.com, The Wall Street Journal Online (www.wsj.com), Forbes.com, SmartMoney.com, MarketWatch.com, The Motley Fool, and CNBC.com, as well as financial portals, such as Yahoo! Finance and Google Finance. The company’s investment index competitors include Morningstar, Dow Jones, Standard & Poor’s, The Financial Times, and MSCI Barra, a public company majority owned by Morgan Stanley.

records.Long Business Description:
Gemini Space Station, Inc. (Gemini) offers a mobile and web based crypto asset exchange platform, proprietary wallet infrastructure and custody solutions, high-performance over-the-counter trading solutions tailored to institutions and professionals, a digital art auction platform, a proprietary United States dollar backed stablecoin, and a credit card product that offers crypto asset rewards on customer purchases. The company operates globally and provides security solutions across all of its product offerings.

As a trusted bridge between the traditional financial system and the emerging cryptoeconomy, the company is providing access for individuals and institutions to a decentralized future that is more open, fair, and secure. As of June 30, 2025, the company served approximately 523,000 Monthly Transacting Users (MTUs) and approximately 10,000 institutions in over 60 countries.

The company's core exchange product has expanded over time to become a comprehensive platform for its users to engage with the cryptoeconomy, including a derivatives exchange, staking services, an OTC trading desk, institutional-grade custody, a NYDFS-regulated stablecoin, a U.S. credit card, and a Web3 studio for NFTs. The company supports a large variety of crypto assets on its platform, including bitcoin, ether, and stablecoins.

The company strives to deliver a seamless user experience to both retail and institutional users:

Retail: The company often serves as a primary gateway for individual retail users into the cryptoeconomy. It provides a user-friendly, secure platform and mobile app for users to buy, sell, store, stake, and transfer a variety of crypto assets. The company's products aim to suit the needs of beginners and sophisticated users alike.

Institutional: The company provides institutional investors, including asset managers, hedge funds, proprietary trading firms, and corporations, with a robust and secure platform to access crypto markets. It offers advanced trading, OTC trading, and institutional-grade custody.

The company operates exchanges through regulated entities in the United States and abroad. In addition, it offers digital asset custody services through Gemini Trust, a New York limited purpose trust company. All customer assets are held in full on the company's platform, ensuring every unit of cryptocurrency or fiat held by a user is available to the user. The company holds MTLs or the statutory equivalent in all states that require such licenses, so that it is able to operate in all 50 states and have direct access to fiat banking rails.

The company's crypto-native technology stack at the core of its platform enables it to support advanced functionality and complex blockchain integrations while serving the demands of a global, 24/7/365 crypto market. Its proprietary, in-house custody solutions enable it to offer products that are both secure and easy to use.

The company's commitment to utilizing and providing both leading-edge crypto technology and institutional-grade security has fueled its track record of innovation. The company's complementary set of products and services addresses core aspects of its users’ crypto journeys, whether they are sophisticated users or new entrants into the space.

The company's platform centers on five core elements:

Learn: The company provides accessible and straightforward educational resources to help its users understand the intricacies of crypto assets. By leveraging its platform, users can access resources similar to those offered by traditional educational tools, such as NerdWallet and Investopedia, but tailored specifically for the crypto landscape.

Invest: The company's platform empowers users to seamlessly buy and sell a wide range of digital assets through an intuitive trading experience. For more advanced traders, the company's Gemini ActiveTrader® tool features advanced charting and multiple order types. Users are able to seamlessly trade and monitor multiple markets simultaneously, execute sophisticated trading strategies, and hedge positions in real-time. The company's Gemini Derivatives offering allows users to gain directional exposure by trading perpetual contracts while managing risk and capital through cross collateralization.

As a fiduciary and qualified custodian, it believes the custody technology underlying its exchange and custody products is on par with that offered by traditional financial institutions. Gemini Custody is supported by a segregated wallet structure, offering institutional-grade storage to users who want to custody their digital assets on a segregated basis.

Earn: The Gemini Credit Card®, an innovative credit card made available by the company, allows users to earn and grow crypto rewards every time they swipe. By making a purchase anywhere in the world where Mastercard is accepted, crypto rewards are automatically and instantly deposited into the cardholder’s Gemini account, where they can then be held, traded, staked, or used however the user wishes.

Nifty Gateway Studio’s immersive, social, and creative experiences provide familiar ways for global consumers to access the crypto landscape, without typical barriers to entry—accepting fiat payment methods, and providing safe, custodial wallets.

Security: The company's infrastructure features geographically distributed Hardware Security Modules (HSM) supporting cold storage, as well as MPC technology. It holds certifications, including SOC 1 Type 2, SOC 2 Type 2, and ISO 27001, which reflect its adherence to rigorous security standards. The company is one of the world’s first crypto asset custodians and exchanges to have completed both SOC 1 Type 2 and SOC 2 Type 2 examinations.

As more users buy, sell, store, and stake different crypto assets, the company's platform gathers valuable insights into user preferences and behaviors. This data allows for ongoing platform optimization through tailored product development and an overall more engaging experience for users. For example, Gemini’s flagship education platform is its Cryptopedia, which provides its users with in-depth, curated articles covering a broad range of crypto topics, from blockchain fundamentals to advanced trading strategies. The company supports mission critical operations for some of the world’s leading companies and leverage the company’s Advanced Technology Solutions, including Data and AI and Agentic Solutions, to help them reimagine the most critical elements of their AI journey – from reengineering business processes to building data and AI capabilities to leading with agentic collaboration.

Advanced Technology Solutions

Data and AI

Digital Technology

These services allow enterprises to be more flexible and focus on high-value work to better compete in their industries. The company’s Digital Operations solutions also include certain information technology (‘IT’) support services for legacy applications, including end-user computing support and infrastructure production support.

records.Long Business Description:
Getty Images Holdings, Inc. operates as a preeminent global visual content creator and marketplace that offers a full range of content solutions to meet the needs of customers around the globe, no matter their size.

Through Getty Images, iStock, and Unsplash brands, websites, and APIs, the company serves customers in almost every country in the world, and is one of the first places people turn to discover, purchase, and share powerful visual content from the world’s best photographers and videographers. The company offers a full range of content, with over 645 million assets available through its industry-leading sites. The company serves businesses in almost every country in the world, with websites in 23 languages, bringing content to media outlets, advertising agencies, and corporations, and, increasingly, serving individual creators and prosumers.

The company has developed market enhancements across e-commerce, content subscriptions, user-generated content, diverse and inclusive content, and proprietary research, alongside investment in the company’s technology platform (which includes generative AI-services designed to be commercially safe, natural language processing, and AI-based integrated APIs). On January 6, 2025, Getty Images entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger to combine in a merger-of-equals transaction with Shutterstock.

Product Offerings

The company’s comprehensive product offering is designed to address the full spectrum of customers’ visual content needs.

Getty Images is the company’s premium offering focused on corporate, agency, and media customers, serving the full breadth of its customers’ content needs by combining the highest quality content with premium support, and customized rights and protections. Customers can purchase on an a la carte basis, and through subscriptions, including the company’s ‘Premium Access’ product, where the company enables customers to access its complete library of creative and editorial images, video, and music, via one website and one set of terms. The company’s assignment capabilities, along with its Custom Content offering—a subscription product that leverages Getty Images’ global network of photographers and videographers to create customized and exclusive project-specific content—enable Getty Images to produce cost-effective content to meet the specific needs of customers. In the fall of 2023, the company launched Generative AI by Getty Images, which is designed to be a commercially safe AI image generation service that is trained with Getty Images creative content.

iStock is the company’s value offering of creative stills and videos, which provides a significant volume of exclusive image and video content to small to medium-sized businesses, furnishing them with a powerful, and cost-efficient means to produce and maintain their visual narrative. Customers can purchase on an a la carte basis, and through a range of monthly and annual subscription options. Customers can also use Generative AI by iStock to create ready-to-use AI-generated content that is designed to be commercially safe, and is trained with Getty Images creative content.

Unsplash is a widely accessed, creative stills offering, serving the fast-growing and broad-based creator economy, ranging from prosumers, and semi-professional creators, to full-time creative professionals working at corporations and agencies. Customers can purchase an unlimited subscription, which includes premium content that has specific legal protections, or download from the millions of free images.

In addition to the company’s websites, customers and partners can access, and integrate its content, metadata, and search capabilities into their workflows via its APIs, such as through Canva, and through a range of mobile apps and plugins, including Adobe Creative Cloud, WordPress, and other publishing and workflow platforms.

In recent years, the company has shifted revenues toward subscription products, including annual subscription products, to drive revenue growth and durability. As of December 31, 2025, annual subscriptions represented more than half of total revenue. The company offers a complete range of subscription products on its Getty Images, iStock, and Unsplash websites. The company’s Premium Access subscription offers all of Getty Images’ Creative and Editorial image and video content, and music in one subscription. The company similarly continues to see more subscription adoption in e-commerce through its iStock subscription, which includes images, video, and music, and Unsplash+, which is an unlimited image-only subscription. In all cases, its annual subscriptions provide greater customer and revenue visibility, and upside through expanded consumption, and ongoing cross-sell and upsell opportunities via the company’s dedicated Customer Success team.

Content & Services

While the company goes to market through its Getty Images, iStock, and Unsplash brands, it categorizes its content and services into three categories—Creative, Editorial, and Other.

Creative: Creative consists of RF photos, illustrations, vectors, videos, and generative AI-services that are released for commercial use, and cover a wide variety of commercial, conceptual, and contemporary subjects, including lifestyle, business, science, health, wellness, beauty, sports, transportation, and travel. This content is available for immediate use by a wide range of customers, with depth, breadth, and quality, allowing the company’s customers to produce impactful websites, digital media, social media, marketing campaigns, corporate collateral, textbooks, movies, television, and online video content relevant to their target geographies, and audiences. The company primarily sources Creative content from a broad network of professional, semi-professional, and amateur creators, many exclusive to Getty Images. The company has a global creative insights team dedicated to providing briefing and art direction to its exclusive contributor community. Annual Subscription products include products and subscriptions with a duration of 12 months or longer, Unsplash API, and Custom Content.

Editorial: Editorial consists of photos and videos covering the world of entertainment, sports, and news. The company combines contemporary coverage of events around the globe, with one of the largest privately held archives globally, with access to images spanning all the way back to the beginning of photography. The company invests in a dedicated editorial team, which includes over 115 staff photographers and videographers, to generate its own coverage, in addition to coverage from its network of content partners. Annual Subscription products include subscriptions with a duration of 12 months or longer.

Other: This includes data access and/or licensing, music licensing, digital asset management, distribution services, and print sales.

With a consistently differentiated, authentic, and high-quality content offering at the company’s core, the company has a rich history of embracing disruption and innovation with regard to how that content is packaged, accessed, licensed, created, and distributed to an evolving universe of customers.

Comprehensive Premium Product Offering

The company’s differentiated, authentic, and high-quality content offering is generated through:

A growing base of more than 600,000 contributors, of which over 83,000 are exclusive to Getty Images.

Over 75 exclusive editorial content partners, such as AFP, Disney, Globo, ITN, Bloomberg, BBC Studios, CBS, The Boston Globe, Fairfax Media, NBC News Archives, and Sky News, who rely upon Getty Images to manage and license their content, and Formula One, NBA, NHL, MLB, NASCAR, FIFA, and International Olympic Committee, who, in addition to distributing content from their events through Getty Images, grant the company unique commercial rights, with event and content access.
