records.Long Business Description:
Giftify, Inc. owns and operates a restaurant deal space in the United States.

The company's profile fundamentally changed with the acquisition of CardCash Exchange, Inc. (CardCash) in December 2023. CardCash buys merchant gift cards from the general public and distributors at a discount, and then resells them at a markup. CardCash’s core service offering includes the buying and selling of gift cards from over 1,100 retailers, including Target, Home Depot, Starbucks, and TJ Maxx, among others.

Business

The company has two principal divisions, B2C and B2B, for both CardCash and for Restaurant.com.

CardCash

CardCash operates as a leading gift card exchange platform, facilitating the purchase and sale of unused gift cards at discounted rates for both consumers and businesses.

CardCash’s core service offering includes the buying and selling of gift cards from over 1,100 retailers, such as Target, Home Depot, Starbucks, and TJ Maxx, among others. By connecting buyers and sellers, CardCash enables consumers to unlock value from unused gift cards and save significant amounts on their purchases.

CardCash purchases unused gift cards at a value lower than their face worth, and subsequently retails them at a discounted rate to discerning shoppers nationwide. This avenue not only allows individuals to obtain cash for their unneeded gift cards, but also enables them to make cost-effective purchases through discounted gift cards.

With advanced fraud prevention technology, known as FraudFix, CardCash ensures the security and integrity of all transactions conducted on its platform. This commitment to trust and reliability has contributed to its success in saving consumers over $100 million since its inception.

In addition to its consumer-focused operations, CardCash provides white-label solutions for brands, allowing them to integrate gift card exchange capabilities into their own platforms. Major retailers, such as Amazon, Best Buy, CVS, and Dell, have capitalized on these solutions to enhance their customer offerings and drive additional revenue streams through gift cards, without compromising product value.

By fostering a mutually beneficial ecosystem, CardCash.com drives a scenario where consumers and businesses effortlessly trade unwanted gift cards, while others access these cards at discounted rates, simultaneously benefiting merchants as unused gift cards are utilized to convert financial liabilities into revenue.

Furthermore, CardCash facilitates Business-to-Business (B2B) exchanges, enabling companies to efficiently manage surplus gift card inventory and procure gift cards in bulk for various business needs.

Moreover, CardCash is committed to social responsibility through partnerships with charitable organizations. Initiatives, such as the collaboration with Charity On Top for fundraising efforts during natural disasters, showcase CardCash’s dedication to giving back to the community. Partnerships with reputable institutions, such as St. Jude’s Research Hospital, demonstrate CardCash’s commitment to supporting critical causes and making a positive impact.

Among its offerings, CardCash Incentives provides new gift cards for over 300 brands at discounted rates, catering to businesses seeking employee engagement and customer loyalty through customized gift card solutions. The recent introduction of the CardCash uChoose platform further enhances the company's portfolio by offering businesses the option to provide gift card choices from a wide selection of brands to recipients.

Overall, CardCash’s multifaceted approach to the gift card market, coupled with its focus on innovation and social impact, positions the company as a key player in the industry, with a strategic vision for continued growth and success.

CardCash Growth Plans

CardCash intends to grow its four business channels, bulk to bulk, bulk to retail, retail to bulk, and retail to retail, to take advantage of the projected expansion by 2026 of the global market for gift cards.

Branded Exchange for Retailer Partnerships

CardCash intends to increase the number of gift card exchanges on partner websites to send traffic to CardCash.com. CardCash launched its first branded exchange partnership with CVS Pharmacy in 2012, and experienced an increase in the amount of spending by both new and existing customers.

CardCash Checkout

CardCash is developing the technology to allow retailers to accept any gift card, anywhere, at any time, to reduce the combined interchange fee for businesses, resulting in newfound money for customers and increasing the average amount purchased. CardCash profits by selling the card on the secondary market; the transaction is sourced from the point of checkout, and by not being on CardCash’s website, it represents a perpetuating network.

CardCash Giving

The purpose of this concept is to allow consumers to pay for their retail purchases with gift cards, and to have the charity of their choice receive a donation, thereby increasing the appeal of using CardCash at checkout. CardCash has developed this donation platform to allow customers to use the power of their shopping to support the charity of their choice. CardCash has an existing partnership with St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital that allows customers to spend gift cards anywhere they want while donating to cutting-edge medical research. 

The giving platform works by CardCash negotiating 5% to 20% discounts on the gift cards, splitting that discount 70/30 with the charity, and giving the retailer a tax write-off of 70%. Through CardCash’s platform, consumers can, for example, help families pay down student loan debt and contribute to research and awareness for childhood illnesses, improved heart health, and more.

Restaurant.com Business to Customer Division

The company's B2C division accounted for approximately 50% of gross revenue in its fiscal year ended December 31, 2024. To its database of 6.2 million customers, the company sells:

Discounted certificates for 10,000 restaurants.

Discount Dining Passes, which provide discounts at 170,000 restaurants and other retailers. These passes provide multiple uses for six months.

Specials by Restaurant.com bundle Restaurant.com certificates with a variety of other entertainment options, including theatre, movies, wine, and travel. Customers have favored these bundled offerings, referred to as Specials, generating significantly greater revenue per customer when compared to purchasing the company's other products. The average order value for these Specials sales is nearly five times that of a certificate purchase. Specials generated over 5% of the company's past year’s B2C revenue from 60% of the B2C orders for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023.

Restaurant.com Business to Business Division

The company's B2B division accounted for approximately 50% of its gross revenue in its fiscal year ended December 31, 2024. The company sells certificates and Discount Dining Passes to corporations and marketers, which use them to generate new customers, increase sales at the point of sale, reward points/customer loyalty, convert to paperless billing and auto-bill payment, motivate specific customer behavior, such as free home repair estimates and test drives for auto dealers, renew subscriptions and memberships, and address customer service issues.

Restaurant.com Other Business

The company also generates revenue through third-party offers and display ad revenue. This comprises a de minimis portion of its gross revenue.

Restaurant.com Attractive Customer Demographics

The company intends to grow and leverage its customer database of 6.2 million, which it believes is of value to merchants for a variety of services and products.

Marketing

The company primarily uses marketing to acquire and retain high-quality merchants and customers, and to promote awareness of its marketplaces.

records.Short Business Description: Global Interactive Technologies, Inc., through its subsidiary, operates as a technology-driven platform company in South Korea.
records.Long Business Description:
Global Interactive Technologies, Inc., through its subsidiary, operates as a technology-driven platform company in South Korea.

The company is connecting global fans of Korean culture through innovative digital experiences. The company operates Faning, a comprehensive interactive platform designed to facilitate content discovery, monetization, user-generated content, and deep community engagement among global fandom communities. The company focuses on leveraging technology to expand Korean culture (Hallyu) beyond traditional K-Pop, spanning digital media, entertainment, and interactive platform services.

FANING (successor to the Fantoo platform)

FANING has become a globally recognized platform for providing an amazing and active community among people that have an interest in K-POP and modern Korean culture. The multifaceted nature of the company’s operations has solidified the business’ reputation as one of the preeminent platforms for fandom. FANING’s users are able to seamlessly interact with each other to discuss exciting K-POP topics.

FANING allows fans to interact within their fandoms and discuss these interests, create and share content, and interact through a number of channels, including (i) secure, direct messaging, (ii) open social pages, and (iii) virtual spaces (FANING Clubs or Clubs). FANING Clubs concentrate on a specific topic, allowing moderators to control the Club functions, and the Club members to aggregate their FP rewards. Integrated within each FANING Club is a Club Vault, a service provided by FANING that allows the individual members of a Club to donate their personal FP to an account held by the Club. The Club Vault allows the Club’s members to aggregate their FP and increase their purchasing power. This increase in purchasing power allows the Club’s individual users to more rapidly accumulate FP and pool their rewards with other users, in order to purchase services, such as fan events or the ability to live stream a concert from their favorite band. Decisions regarding the use of the accumulated FP within the Club Vault are determined by a vote of the Club members.

The company’s users are the core of the business. The company provides its users with customized experiences, including unique interactions within the FANING community. FANING algorithms curate individual user experiences, recommending content, clubs to join, users to connect with, and enabling users to subscribe to keywords and access automatic content geared toward their interests. Through these services, FANING provides the fandom community a way to stay connected and up to date with their fandom communities.

FANING further offers each user the ability to freely create, upload, and monetize their own content by earning in-platform rewards of FP. FANING removes language barriers, providing live chat ability between users worldwide, and global access to platform content, as the FANING platform supports automatic, real-time translation services for 17 languages. FANING also offers a fast, secure, and easy-to-use commerce and user-to-user transaction system. These unique features will allow FANING to generate user loyalty, maintain user interest in the platform, and attract new users.

For growth, the company intends to develop short content (two minutes) that will focus on interesting pop music and cultural topics. These videos will be distributed through FANING, while concurrently being shown on third party social media platforms and video sharing websites. This new aspect of growth is important for a few reasons. First, it will further enhance the strength of the FANING community by fostering a greater degree of engagement. Second, it will allow for greater visibility for K-POP on a global basis. Management will continue to expand this aspect of operations through the life of the business.

The Faning ecosystem

The company designed FANING as an ecosystem that is easy for users to adapt and use all features throughout the platform, and for the company to develop and roll-out new technologies and functionality. FANING’s launch included a rollout of the company’s messenger, community, and club technologies, along with the company’s reward system for users. The reward system is the basis of the FANING ecosystem.

Faning Point (FP)

FP is a measurement of reward points within the FANING platform. Accruing FP allows users to redeem FP for a wide variety of products and services within FANING, including content from other users and artists available on FANING, K-Culture merchandise, and more. FP will be stored and quantified as rewards point within the FANTOO platform under the in-platform reward system structure that consists of (i) the company’s FP reserve account, (ii) the company’s active account for collected advertising revenue, which was converted into FP and ready to distribute to users based on user contributions to the FANING platform, (iii) the company’s recycled FP account, which stores FP after being spent by users to make purchases within the application, and (iv) each user’s individual account stores.

FP Storage and Security

FP are stored and managed through a database that is separate and apart from other databases used to store and manage other FANING app data. The separate FP database is operated to ensure maximum data confidentiality by minimizing access to the database and limiting the number of individuals who are able to access such database. Access to the database is limited to permitted IP bands, and the backup function of the cloud service used to store data can be restored within a few hours in the event of a disaster recovery event, such as a server failure.

User-to-User Interactions

The company developed FANING to include numerous opportunities for its users to engage with the platform, including clubs, community forums, chat functions, and functionality to create user-generated content, each of which are intended to build the FANING brand and deepen the loyalty of its users.

FANING Clubs

FANING Clubs are user-created based upon areas of interest in order to link users across the globe and create friendships. Users have the ability to create clubs based upon topics of their own choosing, such as favorite artists, television series, movies, video games, sports, and more. A club can be customized by its moderator according to various policies and preferences to cultivate a close group of users based upon a shared culture. Integrated within each FANING Club is a Club Vault, a service provided by FANING that allows the individual members of a Club to donate their personal FP to an account held by the Club. The Club Vault allows the Club’s members to aggregate their FP and increase their purchasing power. This increase in purchasing power allows the Club’s users to more rapidly accumulate FP and pool their rewards, in order to purchase services, such as fan events or the ability to live stream a concert from their favorite band. Decisions regarding the use of accumulated FP within the Club Vault are determined by a vote of the Club members.

FANING Communities

FANING communities are open forums where user-generated content is socially promoted and curated by FANING users. Once user requests for a community based around a certain topic exceed a pre-determined threshold, the FANING platform will create such a community based upon the users submitting the requests.

FANING Chats

Real-time multilingual translation capability, offered in 17 languages, allows both private messages and open chats via the FANING chats function without language barriers. Messages and chats are protected utilizing end-to-end encryption to prevent leakage of personal information. End-to-end encryption is a system of secured communication to prevent third parties from accessing chat messages, increasing the level of security.

records.Long Business Description:
Global Tech Industries Group, Inc. (GTII) operates an online cryptocurrency trading platform that provides access to digital currency.

The company launched Beyond Blockchain (a GTII company) on June 18, 2021, an online cryptocurrency trading platform. Beyond Blockchain is a registered Money Services Business under FINTRAC guidelines and incorporates world class AML and KYC technology. The KYC (know your customer) and AML (anti money laundering) technologies utilize software to identify users through the use of photo identification and pinpoint their transactions to enhance transparency and reduce the possibility of fraud. They use two factor authentication to secure customers' assets, as well as AI liveness testing to secure the user experience. Beyond Blockchain allows multi-currency clearing and direct settlements in Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Tether (USDT), Bitcoin Cash (BCH), Litecoin (LTC), Bitcoin SV (BSV), Aave (AAVE), Compound (COMP), Uniswap (UNI), Chainlink (LINK) and Yearn Finance (YFI).

Beginning in April of 2021, the company has been working towards tokenizing its fine art collection. If the company's prospectus is approved, the company would mint 1,000,000,000 tokens of the GFT Token, with 26,000,000 of them being registered for distribution.

On September 3, 2021, the company formed a new subsidiary, incorporated in the state of Nevada, named Global Tech Health, Inc. (GTHI). GTHI is wholly-owned by the company and is intended to act as the holding company for any acquired healthcare related assets.

Intellectual Property

With the acquisition of BioEnergy Applied Technologies, Inc., the company acquired fifteen intellectual properties pertaining to the construction of the mobile configuration and operation of the glyd-arc medical waste destruction unit, as well as an enhanced configuration and novel method for coal gasification.

History

The company, a Nevada corporation, was founded in 1980. It was formerly known as Tree Top Industries, Inc. and changed its name to Global Tech Industries Group, Inc. in 2016.

records.Short Business Description: Goobit Group AB (publ) provides crypto exchange services in Sweden.
records.Long Business Description:
Goobit Group AB (publ) (Goobit Group) is a company that operates in the cryptocurrency sector. The company is primarily engaged in providing a platform for trading cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin and other digital assets. Goobit Group aims to facilitate the buying, selling, and trading of cryptocurrencies.

Business Segments

Goobit Group operates primarily in the cryptocurrency trading segment, which encompasses various activities related to the buying, selling, and exchange of digital currencies. The company’s trading platform is designed to cater to both individual and institutional investors, providing an interface and trading tools. The platform supports a range of cryptocurrencies.

Business Strategy

Goobit Group's business strategy revolves around strengthening its position in the cryptocurrency market. The company is focused on enhancing its trading platform to provide a seamless user experience, which is critical in attracting and retaining customers. By continuously improving its technology and user interface, Goobit Group aims to differentiate itself from competitors and establish itself as a leading cryptocurrency exchange.

The company is also committed to expanding its market presence through strategic acquisitions and partnerships. The acquisition of Snowbank AB's assets is a testament to Goobit Group's proactive approach in seeking opportunities that align with its growth objectives. By integrating Snowbank's brand, technology, and customer base, the company expects to bolster its market share and enhance its service offerings.

Products and Services

Goobit Group offers a range of products and services tailored to meet the needs of cryptocurrency traders and investors. The company's primary offering is its trading platform, which facilitates the buying, selling, and exchange of various cryptocurrencies. The platform is designed to be user-friendly, providing both novice and experienced traders with the tools they need to navigate the cryptocurrency market effectively.

In addition to trading services, Goobit Group provides educational resources to help users understand the intricacies of cryptocurrency investments. These resources may include articles, tutorials, and webinars that cover topics such as market analysis, trading strategies, and risk management. Goobit Group also prioritizes customer support, ensuring that users have access to assistance when needed. The company offers various channels for customer inquiries, including email support and live chat options.

Geographical Markets Served

Goobit Group primarily serves the Swedish market, where it has established itself as a reputable cryptocurrency exchange.

Recent Acqusitions

In May 2023, Goobit Group made a significant acquisition by purchasing assets from Snowbank AB, a well-known Swedish Bitcoin exchange service. This acquisition is expected to enhance Goobit Group's market position and expand its customer base. The integration of Snowbank's brand, technology, and customer base into Goobit Group's operations is anticipated to create synergies and improve service offerings.

Customers

Goobit Group serves a customer base that includes individual traders, institutional investors, and cryptocurrency enthusiasts. The company’s trading platform is designed to accommodate users with varying levels of experience, from beginners to seasoned traders.

Sales and Marketing

Goobit Group employs various modes of sales and marketing to promote its trading platform and attract customers. The company utilizes digital marketing strategies, including social media campaigns, search engine optimization (SEO), and content marketing, to reach potential users. By leveraging online channels, Goobit Group aims to increase brand awareness and drive traffic to its platform.

Additionally, the company may engage in partnerships and collaborations with other players in the cryptocurrency ecosystem to expand its reach and enhance its service offerings. By aligning with complementary businesses, Goobit Group can tap into new customer segments and create synergies that benefit both parties.

records.Short Business Description: Grindr Inc. operates a social networking and dating application for the lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, and queer (LGBTQ) communities worldwide.
records.Long Business Description:
Grindr Inc. (Grindr) operates a social networking platform primarily serving and addressing the needs of gay, bisexual, and sexually explorative adults around the world.

The company had 15.0 million Average Monthly Active Users (MAUs) for the year ended December 31, 2025. Additionally, the company had 1.3 million Average Paying Users for the year ended December 31, 2025. The company enables its users to find and engage with one another, share content and interests, discover products and experiences relevant for them, and generally express their unique selves. As a ‘gayborhood’ on its users’ mobile devices, the company’s platform is a meaningful part of its users’ lives and has embedded it at the center of their communities, as they seek relationships of various forms, whether intimate, romantic, or social.

Community Focus

As a company built by gay people for gay people, Grindr fulfills crucial needs for its users.

While the broader global landscape of social networks is highly competitive, with many different platforms, there are few global platforms that focus solely on the gay, bisexual, transgender, and queer (‘GBTQ’) community, and address their unique needs. The company’s platform enables GBTQ adults to connect with one another and the world. Its users have a range of intentions and use cases. The company’s platform helps its users find what they are looking for: casual dating, long-term relationships, community and friendships, professional networking, travel information, and local discovery.

Platform Integration

The Grindr platform has become an integral part of the daily lives of millions of users, enabling them to discover and connect with one another effortlessly, anytime.

The Grindr platform offers a variety of location-based social features and functions, including identity expression (profile, photos, presence, Taken on Grindr); connection (search, filters, the Cascade, Viewed Me, Right Now, recommendations); and interaction (chat, media sharing, Discover, interactive map); with trust and safety tools across the experience, and subscriptions for premium features offering further access and control. Since its inception, the company has continued to innovate and enhance the Grindr platform, adding new features and safety elements, which has allowed it to increase engagement of its monthly active users (‘MAUs’). The Grindr platform has benefited from first mover advantage globally, resulting in MAUs in over 190 countries and territories.

User Base and Engagement

The company has attracted a highly engaged and growing user base, as evidenced by the following:

15.0 million Average MAUs in 2025, increased by 5.2% in 2025 as compared to 2024.

1.3 million Average Paying Users in 2025, increased by 16.9% in 2025 as compared to 2024.

MAUs in over 190 countries and territories in the world as of December 31, 2025.

21 supported languages on the platform as of December 31, 2025.

Platform Expansion and Impact

The Grindr platform offers a combination of social networking functions and digital content, and the company has continued to expand its platform and impact in the following ways:

The company helps people find meaningful connections, whether it’s casual dating, relationships and love, community and friendships, travel information, or local discovery.

The company’s platform builds community and friendships. The user experience is essentially a world without walls, connecting one user to the next, allowing the community to see one another.

The company strives to make a world where the lives of its global community are free, safe, equal, and just.

Grindr for Equality is a core initiative at Grindr dedicated to accelerating a world where LGBTQ people in every country are equal before the law, are free to marry, and have their unique health needs met. In partnership with public health authorities and LGBTQ non-governmental organizations, Grindr for Equality harnesses the power of the Grindr platform, and provides funding to advance key health and human rights priorities for the community.

The company further supports the LGBTQ community through donations to local, national, and international LGBTQ organizations.

The company drives social influence in fun and engaging ways on its social media channels and blog, to help the general population better understand the community, challenges, and interconnectedness.

Products and Services

Core Product

The company’s flagship product, the Grindr platform, is primarily a mobile application (with some post-account-creation uses available for some users on the web), with location-based connectivity features designed to help its users find one another and have meaningful interactions right here and now, or anywhere globally. The company’s mobile application is free to use, with premium subscription offerings available for users preferring greater access to other users and more control over their experience.

Key features of the Grindr platform include:

Identity expression: Users can create, manage, and control their identity, profile, and presence on the platform.

Connection: Users can find and be found by those they are interested in; those nearby right now, or anywhere globally.

Interaction: Users can chat and interact with any profile instantly, in an open, fun, and engaging way.

Ecosystem Health and Safety: Users receive protections, guidance, and tools designed to help them be safe across their platform experience.

The free version of the service provides many of the features above on a limited basis for a valuable initial experience. Users can subscribe for premium features and services, giving them greater access to more profiles, as well as additional control over the experience of finding others and forming meaningful connections.

In 2025, the company began testing Edge, a premium AI-native product tier, designed to aggregate its AI-native capabilities specifically for users seeking advanced capabilities. The company is focused on strategically positioning Edge and other AI products to expand monetization through a cohesive premium stack that aims to deliver differentiated value.

Gayborhood Expansion

In May 2025, the company launched Woodwork by Grindr as part of its first gayborhood expansion initiative focusing on the health and wellness space.

Woodwork is a telehealth subscription service that facilitates access for eligible patients to certain treatments and prescription medications, including compounded medications. It is currently powered by OpenLoop Health Inc. and its affiliated practices (‘OpenLoop’), a partner for clinical support. Looking ahead, the company is continuing to consider a broad set of potential products and services to support gayborhood expansion, including in sectors such as travel, events, lifestyle, and media production.

Growth Strategies

The key elements of the company’s growth strategy are to expand monetization capabilities, grow its user base, invest in understanding its user journey, continue to strengthen its global brand, focusing on gayborhood expansion opportunities, and strategic investments and acquisitions.

Branding and Marketing

The company continues to expand its user base through user-driven organic growth, supported by the scale of its global network and sustained engagement across the platform.

The company’s marketing efforts are focused on reinforcing relevance, trust, and product engagement and monetization through content, owned channels, cultural partnerships, and experiential activations.

In 2024, the company made progress reshaping the perception of Grindr as the Global Gayborhood in Your Pocket, and in 2025, it advanced its positioning by more deliberately linking brand activity to product strategy and cultural presence. Rather than relying on passive brand recognition, the company’s marketing and communications emphasized participation i

records.Short Business Description: Gumtree Australia Markets Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates a digital business news and investor relations platform in Australia and internationally.
records.Long Business Description:
Gumtree Australia Markets Limited operates in the digital media sector. The company engages in various activities, including online classified advertising and media services.

Business Segments

The company operates through four main segments. These segments include the Australian classified business, known as Gumtree, the Canadian digital community represented by Stockhouse, the car leasing operations labeled as Subscribacar, and other digital media activities.

Gumtree

This segment serves as a popular online classified platform within Australia, providing users with a space to buy, sell, and trade various goods and services. It promotes user engagement by allowing individuals to interact directly with one another, establishing a peer-to-peer economy. The platform includes a range of categories, from real estate and automotive to personal items and services.

Stockhouse

This segment operates within the Canadian market, focusing on serving the financial sector by offering a platform for investors and industry stakeholders. Stockhouse provides essential news, financial analysis, and user-driven discussion forums that enable users to explore investment opportunities and engage with fellow investors. Its emphasis on connecting people and resources.

Subscribacar

This segment, as a unique car leasing service, Subscribacar allows customers to engage in a flexible car leasing experience, setting it apart from traditional car rental practices. Unlike conventional leasing agreements, Subscribacar enables users to choose and change vehicles freely without the long commitment periods typical of traditional leases. By adapting to modern consumer needs, Subscribacar thrives as a nexus of car leasing and advertising.

Additional Digital Media Activities

This segment, the company further diversifies its offerings through various additional platforms and initiatives aimed at augmenting its presence in the digital space.

Business Strategy

The company’s business strategy underscores a commitment to innovation, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction, aimed at consolidating its position in competitive markets and fostering long-term growth. At the core of the strategy is the commitment to technological advancement, focusing on investing in digital assets and platforms that enhance user experience.

The company also emphasizes the importance of market research and analytics. The ability to gather and interpret data plays a pivotal role in the company’s strategic planning. Analyzing consumer behavior allows the company to adjust its offerings proactively, catering to emerging trends and preferences, and ensuring that products and services meet customer expectations.

Additionally, the company is keen on strategic partnerships and collaborations that expand its influence and capacity. Forming alliances with other entities in digital media and technology enhances market reach, facilitates resource sharing, and encourages knowledge transfer, positioning the company for sustainable growth.

Products and Services

The company offers an array of products and services tailored to the specific needs of its segments. Each segment retains its unique product offerings, creating a spectrum of solutions across digital platforms.

Gumtree: The company's flagship online classifieds service is designed to facilitate the buying, selling, and trading of goods and services. By providing a platform for advertisements across multiple categories, it enables users to reach potential customers efficiently. The service includes features such as user-generated reviews, merchant promotions, and business listings.

Stockhouse: This segment offers financial news, analysis, and forums focused on investment discussions. Stockhouse’s community-driven aspect allows users to share insights and experiences, fostering a collaborative environment that encourages informed investment decisions.

Subscribacar: In addition to car leasing, Subscribacar combines advertising and retail leasing services, presenting an innovative solution for customers who desire flexibility in transportation without the hassle of long-term commitments. The functionality serves a dual purpose of enhancing customer experience while promoting businesses that utilize this flexible leasing model.

Additional Media Services: Beyond the primary segments, the company incorporates various advertising solutions across its platforms, enabling businesses to engage with audiences through various formats including display ads, sponsored listings, and promotional campaigns.

Geographical Markets Served

The company operates primarily in Australia and Canada, leveraging the unique market characteristics and consumer behavior in these regions. The Australian market comprises several customer segments, reflecting the robust demand for digital media and classified services. In Canada, the focus remains on the investment sector, where Stockhouse plays a pivotal role.

Seasonality

The company’s operations demonstrate some degree of seasonality, typically experiencing fluctuations in user engagement and advertising revenue based on market conditions, consumer behavior, and economic cycles.

Customers

The company serves a broad spectrum of customers, ranging from individual consumers engaged in buying and selling daily products to businesses seeking advertising solutions for their services. The company has a customer base encompassing over 60,000 Australian customers.

Trade Names

The company maintains several trade names across its various segments with the portfolio typically includes trademarks associated with its primary platforms such as Gumtree and Stockhouse.

Sales and Marketing/Marketing/Distribution Channels

The company employs diverse sales and marketing channels to reach its customers effectively. The company relies heavily on digital marketing, utilizing search engine optimization, social media, and email marketing campaigns to increase brand visibility and engage users.

In addition, partnerships with various businesses enhance distribution channels, allowing the company to extend its reach and improve customer experiences. The focus is not just on selling but on creating a community around its platforms that fosters user engagement and loyalty.

History

The company was incorporated in 2016. The company was formerly known as The Market Herald Limited and changed its name to The Market Limited in 2023 and then to Gumtree Australia Markets Limited in January 2025.

records.Long Business Description:
Hello Group Inc. provides mobile-based social and entertainment services.

Through Momo, Tantan, and other properties within the company's product portfolio, it enables users to discover new relationships, expand their social connections, and build meaningful interactions. Momo is a mobile application that connects people and facilitates social interactions based on location, interests, and a variety of online recreational activities. Tantan, which the company added to its family of applications through acquisition in May 2018, is a leading social and dating application. Tantan is designed to help its users find and establish romantic connections, as well as meet interesting people. Starting from 2019, the company has incubated several other new apps, such as Hertz, Soulchill, and Duidui, which target more niche markets and more selective demographics both domestically and internationally.

The company seeks to improve the profitability of its Momo business, and it monitors the number and spending of Momo paying users as an indicator of its performance. The number of paying users of the Momo app was 5.7 million for the fourth quarter of 2024. The decrease in Momo’s paying users in 2024 was primarily due to the company's strategic emphasis on profitability. This strategic focus resulted in a reduction in the acquisition of low-paying users with negative ROI, which is conducive to enhancing profitability.

The Momo Platform

The company's Momo platform includes its Momo mobile application and a variety of related properties, features, functionalities, tools, and services. The Momo platform enables users to discover new relationships, expand their social connections, and build meaningful interactions. It connects people and facilitates interactions over a rich collection of social experiences based on location, interests, content sharing, and a variety of recreational activities, including live talent shows, short videos, as well as other video- and audio-based interactive experiences, such as online parties, mobile karaoke, and user-participated reality shows. Communications within the Momo platform are supported by multi-media instant messaging tools and other audio- and video-based communication tools and services.

The Tantan Platform

Tantan is a leading social and dating application, which is designed to help its users find and establish romantic connections, as well as meet interesting people. Tantan has become one of the leading choices for mobile internet users in the Chinese mainland to discover new relationships. Tantan’s users can enjoy many of the core features of Tantan for free. For example, Tantan users can swipe through a pool of people to find potential matches and communicate with the matches through the instant messaging tool on the Tantan app. Tantan users can also create and share content or discover new connections via content shared by other users. However, to enjoy certain premium features, a user must pay a monthly subscription fee or purchase the premium features on an à la carte basis. Tantan also facilitates other social experiences outside of the swipe-and-match mechanism to help users discover new relationships and interact in more diversified ways. Such social experiences mainly include live video, audio chatrooms, and the ‘Quick Chat’ experience.

Other Applications

The social and dating markets are highly fragmented. Users may have different social demands and preferences in terms of how they discover new relationships and build interactions. Therefore, a brand portfolio approach may allow the company to penetrate the market faster and more effectively. Starting from 2019, the company has incubated a number of other new apps, such as Hertz, Soulchill, and Duidui, which target more niche markets and more selective demographics both domestically and internationally. In addition, the company has also been seeking opportunities to expand its footprint in the overseas social space through acquisitions. Starting from 2022, the revenue from the overseas market, represented by revenue contributed by Soulchill, increased significantly due to its successful operation in the Middle East and North Africa markets, and the revenue contribution from the overseas market has become increasingly important to the company.

Monetization Opportunities

The company offers a wide variety of products that capture the needs of users from all demographics and socioeconomic statuses. Throughout the years, it has continued to create new products and services by closely following market dynamics and users’ evolving social needs. Through constant product and operational innovations, the company has effectively monetized features through a wide variety of virtual gift experiences, which not only generate revenue but also encourage interactions among users. The company has two major business lines for monetization: live video services and value-added services. In addition, it also generates revenues from mobile marketing services and other services.

Live Video Service

The company’s live video services allow Momo, Tantan, and Soulchill users to livestream a variety of content and activities, including talent shows such as singing, dancing, and talk shows, as well as engage in casual chatting and other forms of interactions between broadcasters and viewers. The broadcasters are able to “go live” and connect with their audience via their mobile phones or personal computers, while audience members are able to interact on a real-time basis with the broadcasters and other fellow viewers by texting for free or purchasing and sending virtual gifts. The company shares a portion of the revenues generated with the broadcasters or their talent agencies. Broadcasters provide live video services on the company's platforms as individuals or as members of a talent agency. Certain broadcasters are also paying users on the company's platforms. The talent agencies recruit, train, and retain the broadcasters. The company monetizes live video services via virtual gifts. Its live video services generated 48.2% of its net revenues in 2024.

Value-Added Service

The company’s value-added service primarily consists of subscription services on the Momo and Tantan platforms that provide paying users with additional features, functions, and privileges. In the fourth quarter of 2016, it started to offer virtual gift services within its family of applications, which allow users to purchase and send virtual gifts to other users outside of the live video service. The company also introduced virtual item sales in its virtual community services in 2019. It generated 50.4% of its net revenues from value-added services in 2024.

Mobile Marketing Services

The company seeks to provide advertising and marketing solutions to enable its customers to promote their brands and conduct effective marketing activities. It offers full-screen banner ads that appear before the application is loaded. The company may occasionally offer other forms of display ads. It started to provide advertising services on the Tantan app in 2023.

Mobile Games

The company offered games with the aim of increasing interactions between users and broadening its revenue sources. In 2023, it strategically decided to deprioritize its game development and distribution business and focus on other areas with greater potential for growth and user acquisition. Mobile games contributed less than 0.1% of the company’s revenues in 2024. The company has ceased offering mobile games and related services since early 2024.

Other Services

The company’s other services include other revenue-generating services that are immaterial in revenue contribution or are not considered part of its strategic focus. Other services contributed less than 0.1% of its revenues in 2024.

records.Short Business Description: Hemnet Group AB (publ) operates a residential property platform in Sweden.
records.Long Business Description:
Hemnet Group AB (publ) primarily facilitates real estate transactions through a digital platform that connects property sellers, buyers, and real estate agents. 

Business Segments

The company operates primarily within the real estate sector, providing a comprehensive platform for property listings and associated services aimed at facilitating transactions between buyers and sellers. The core business segments include residential property listings, value-added services for real estate agents and sellers, and advertising solutions. 

Residential Property Listing Segment

The residential property listing segment functions as a digital marketplace where property owners can list their homes for sale, while potential buyers can search for properties that fit their criteria. The platform serves as an intermediary connecting sellers with prospective buyers, providing an essential service in the property transaction process. The company's user-friendly interface features robust search capabilities, enabling users to filter listings based on various attributes such as property size, price, location, and amenities.

Value-Added Services

This segment offers value-added services to enhance the offerings for real estate agents and improve seller engagement. The introduction of premium packages and features such as the company, which boosts visibility for listings, reflects the company's strategic drive towards generating additional revenue streams from agent recommendations and premium publicity options. This shift towards value-added services has increased the conversion of standard listings to premium listings, resulting in a significant uptick in revenue from property sellers.

Advertising Solutions Segment 

The advertising solutions form a crucial part of the company's business segments. The company provides advertisers the opportunity to reach a targeted audience through tailored marketing campaigns, further diversifying its income sources. Whether through display ads or sponsored listings, the company’s advertising options allow businesses to capture the attention of potential customers browsing the platform.

Business Strategy

The company’s strategic focus revolves around enhancing the user experience on the company platform, improving service offerings for property sellers and real estate agents alike, and maintaining its competitive edge in the dynamic property marketplace. This entails continuous investment in technology and user interface improvements to create an engaging and efficient browsing experience for both buyers and sellers.

One of the strategic pillars involves the successful expansion and promotion of the company’s package, which significantly enhances the visibility of property listings. By offering unique features that differentiate standard listings from premium ones, the company aims to foster an environment where agents and sellers recognize the tangible benefits of investing in premium visibility.

Another aspect of the strategy is dedicated to increasing collaboration with real estate agents, thereby incentivizing them to recommend the company’s services to their clients. This approach is facilitated through a new compensation model designed to reward agents for promoting upgrades to premium services alongside their traditional commission structure.

Furthermore, the company’s commitment to data analytics plays a pivotal role in strategy implementation. Continuous refinement of the platform is guided by data-driven insights aimed at understanding user behavior and preferences. By leveraging these insights, the company can further tailor its product offerings and enhance marketing strategies, ensuring alignment with consumer wants.

Products and Services

The company's primary offerings include a robust digital platform for property listings, tailored value-added services for sellers and real estate agents, and targeted advertising solutions.

Property Listing Service

The property listing service is the cornerstone of the company’s business. Users are presented with detailed listings that include property descriptions, images, and essential information such as pricing and locality details, facilitating informed purchasing decisions.

Value-Added Services

The value-added services encompass various features designed to enhance user engagement and boost listing visibility. The company stands out as a major service, allowing sellers to opt for enhanced listing features, which significantly increases the likelihood of property exposures to a wider audience. By offering tailored packages that include various promotional elements, the company successfully caters to different needs and budgets.

Specialized Services

The company provides specialized services for real estate agents, focusing on improving their listing management efficiency and providing resources that facilitate better engagement with potential buyers. These services are intended to create a holistic approach to real estate transactions, integrating advanced technology and marketing strategies into the selling process.

Advertising Component

The advertising component allows businesses to leverage the company’s wide audience reach, employing various methods such as digital ads and sponsored listings. These targeted marketing solutions generate revenue for the company offer relevant engagement for advertisers within the property market.

Geographical Markets Served

The company primarily serves the Swedish property market, targeting local sellers, buyers, and real estate professionals. The company's focus is firmly on enhancing its footprint within Sweden.

Seasonality

Due to the nature of the real estate market, seasonality plays a significant role in the company’s business operations. The property market typically experiences increased activity during the spring and early summer months, coinciding with favorable weather conditions and families looking to relocate before the school year starts. Conversely, activity tends to slow during winter months, especially around holiday seasons, impacting the volume of transaction listings on the platform.

Customers

The company serves a diverse customer base encompassing property seller, potential buyers, real estate agents, property developers, and advertisers. The company provides its digital platform to hundreds of thousands of unique users each month, reflecting the dynamic nature of the Swedish property market.

Sales and Marketing

The company employs a multi-faceted approach to marketing, utilizing digital channels to reach its target audience effectively. The company primary mode of marketing revolves around online advertising, search engine optimization, and strategic partnerships with real estate professionals to increase visibility. Distribution channels are heavily focused on digital platforms, ensuring that the property listings and services reach potential customers through various online touchpoints effectively.

History

Hemnet Group AB (publ) was founded in 1998. The company was incorporated in 2016.

records.Long Business Description:
Himalaya Technologies, Inc., through its wholly owned subsidiary, KANAB CORP., operates as a development stage company.

As of July 31, 2023, the company had one investment, Peer to Peer Network, Inc. (PTOP). KANAB CORP. is targeting information services for the cannabis industry using its social site Kanab.Club (https://kanab.club/).

On November 28, 2021, the company executed a 19.9% stock purchase with GenBio, Inc. (‘GenBio’; https://www.genbioinc.com/), a provider of nutraceutical products and services based on proprietary biotechnology that fight inflammation and high blood pressure. On May 16, 2023, the company unwound its investment in GenBio.

On January 1, 2022, the company executed a 19.9% stock purchase with The Agrarian Group LLC (‘TAG’; http://www.theagrariangroup.com/), a provider of digital intelligence ‘AgtechDi’ software designed from its granted patents to optimize the food supply chain by increasing food safety and profitability for growers who operate vertical farms, greenhouses, converted shipping containers, and other forms of controlled environment agriculture. TAG is focusing its technology on the broad produce market, but in the future may offer it to cannabis cultivators. TAG is a software platform and will never touch the cannabis plant, eliminating regulatory risk, in the company’s view. On April 3, 2023, the company unwound its investment in TAG.

The company’s business plan included completing its social site Kanab.Club targeting health and wellness focused on the cannabis market, generating revenues from advertising and subscriptions, incorporating social media site into the site, and marketing its planned social sites, including Goccha.net and Yinzworldwide.com.

History

Himalaya Technologies, Inc., also known as Homeland Resources Ltd., was incorporated in 2003 under the laws of the state of Nevada.

records.Short Business Description: hipages Group Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an online tradie marketplace in Australia and New Zealand.
records.Long Business Description:
hipages Group Holdings Limited operates as a leading online marketplace for tradies in both Australia and New Zealand. The company focuses on connecting residential and commercial consumers with skilled tradespeople through its digital platforms. The flagship platform, the company, is recognized as Australia's largest online tradie marketplace, showcasing a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) model. This platform has significantly transformed the process of hiring tradies.

In addition to the company platform, the Australian segment incorporates Tradiecore, a proprietary workflow management tool designed to enhance the operations of tradies. Tradiecore empowers tradespeople by providing comprehensive management solutions, including lead generation, project execution, and payments. This strategic integration signals the company's commitment to evolving from a simple marketplace into a robust platform that adds more value to its users.

In New Zealand, the company operates through Builderscrack, which holds the position as the leading online marketplace for trades and services. By connecting consumers with tradespeople in New Zealand, builderscrack enriches the service experience while focusing on the everyday needs of the market.

Business Segments

The company has segmented its operations into two primary reportable segments: Australia and New Zealand, each leveraging tailored strategies to cater to local needs while maintaining the robustness of a unified platform model.

In the Australian market, the company platform serves as the predominant online marketplace for trades. The segment's infrastructure facilitates the connection between tradies and consumers, streamlining the process of service delivery within various trades, including plumbing, electrical work, and carpentry. The continuous evolution of the company platform enables users to experience unparalleled convenience when engaging with skilled tradespeople.

Furthermore, the segment integrates Tradiecore, which bolsters the operational capabilities of trades through enhanced workflow management. By allowing tradies to oversee their business processes efficiently, from lead generation to payment collection, Tradiecore exemplifies the company's shift towards creating a holistic ecosystem that nurtures tradie success and consumer satisfaction.

The New Zealand segment operates through Builderscrack, which adopts a similar operational model to the company but tailors its offerings to fit the local market dynamics. It focuses on fostering connections between skilled tradespeople and consumers, enhancing service delivery while streamlining project management.

The segment information showcases the company's dedication to diversified growth strategies tailored to local market conditions, ensuring that operational effectiveness aligns with consumer expectations, ultimately leading to mutual benefits for tradies and homeowners alike.

Business Strategy

The business strategy of the company centers around enhancing its digital platforms to facilitate effortless connections between consumers and tradespeople. This foundational approach aims at driving user engagement and satisfaction, thereby increasing the overall efficiency of service delivery across its markets.

The company’s strategic framework involves leveraging technology to streamline processes, from project initiation to conclusion. By providing valuable tools such as Tradiecore, the company ensures that tradies can manage their workflows more effectively, directly impacting their productivity and profitability. This evolution empowers tradespeople not just to secure leads but also to cultivate lasting business relationships and enhance customer loyalty.

In addition to optimizing the user experience the company is focused on increasing its market share in both Australia and New Zealand by continually innovating its offerings. The company is committed to delivering value-added features that resonate with the needs of its users. By maintaining an open channel for feedback and adapting its platform based on user interactions, the company aims to remain competitive in a rapidly evolving digital marketplace.

Moreover, the company aims to expand its reach in untapped geographical regions and diversify its service categories. Future growth strategies are likely to encompass not just residential but also commercial services, all while maintaining a focus on quality control and compliance with local regulations.

Products and Services

The company offers a suite of products and services designed to bridge the gap between consumers and tradespeople effectively. The core product, of the company, serves as a comprehensive online marketplace where consumers can search for, compare, and hire local tradies for various home improvement projects.

Through the company platform, consumers gain access to reviews, ratings, and profiles of various tradies, enabling informed decisions based on parameters such as experience, pricing, and customer satisfaction. The platform is designed to facilitate easy communication, allowing for seamless interactions between consumers and trades.

Tradiecore is another pivotal service offered by the company This proprietary workflow management tool allows tradies to manage their entire business operations, from lead acquisition to project completion. By centralizing all workflows, Tradiecore helps tradies improve their business efficiency, ultimately leading to better service delivery and customer experiences.

In New Zealand, Builderscrack mirrors the structure of the company platform while tailoring its services to meet local market demands. It provides users with an intuitive interface that simplifies the hiring process of skilled tradespeople, further enhancing the consumer's experience in the marketplace.

Geographical Markets Served

The company primarily operates within the Australian and New Zealand markets. Within Australia, it has solidified its position as the leading online marketplace for trades, servicing various states including New South Wales, Victoria, and Queensland. Its platform provides a streamlined way for homeowners to connect with skilled tradespeople within these regions, fulfilling a critical need in the service sectors.

The company has successfully expanded its operations into New Zealand, where it has established Builderscrack as the top online platform for trades. This expansion signifies the company's commitment to delivering exceptional service across Australian and New Zealand markets.

Recent Acquisitions/Sale of Segment/Division/Subsidiary/Business

The company has demonstrated strategic expansion within its operational landscape, particularly through its acquisition of MyQuote Limited, which operates as Builderscrack in New Zealand. This acquisition reflects the company's commitment to deepening its market penetration and enhancing service offerings in the New Zealand region.

The decision to integrate Builderscrack under the company umbrella highlights the strategic importance of building a comprehensive tradie platform that can fulfill the evolving needs of consumers in diverse markets.

Seasonality

The company experiences a degree of seasonality in its business operations, reflective of market demand fluctuations for trades and services. Typically, peak seasons coincide with periods of increased home improvement activities, such as spring and summer, leading to a rise in consumer engagements on the platform.

Conversely, the winter months may witness a decline in engagement as external conditions become less favorable for service-based projects. The seasonal nature of tradie-related work ultimately informs the company's marketing strategies and user engagement efforts, allowing it to align its operations with market demand.

records.Short Business Description: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited, together with its subsidiaries, owns and operates stock and futures exchanges, and related clearing houses in Hong Kong, the United Kingdom, and Mainland China.
records.Long Business Description:
Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited owns and operates stock exchanges and futures exchanges, and related clearing houses. The company offers a comprehensive suite of services, which encompass securities trading, equity and debt issuance, and clearing and settlement services.

Business Segments

The company conducts its operations through various business segments that cater to distinct market needs. The primary segments include the following:

Cash Markets: This segment is pivotal as it encompasses the trading of equity securities and other related instruments. The company efficiently facilitates the listing, trading, and clearing of stocks, which is fundamental for capital raising and investment facilitation.

Derivatives Markets: Through its derivatives markets, the company provides a platform for traders to hedge risk and speculate on price movements in underlying assets. The segment includes futures and options contracts that span different asset classes, which help market participants manage risk exposure efficiently.

Commodities Markets: The commodities segment involves trading in various physicals and derivatives, including agriculture, energy, and metals. The company has established itself as a significant player in this domain, catering to the needs of participants involved in production, consumption, and hedging strategies within commodity markets.

Clearing and Settlement Services: An integral part of the company’s operations is its clearing and settlement services, which ensure the safety and efficiency of transactions processed within its markets. The company employs stringent risk management protocols to mitigate counterparty risks, providing peace of mind to investors and trading participants.

Market Data and Information Services: The company also focuses on providing market data and statistical analysis services, crucial for market participants in making informed investment decisions.

Business Strategy

The company’s business strategy revolves around its commitment to becoming a globally leading financial marketplace while addressing the diverse needs of market participants. Central to this strategy is the focus on continuous innovation, regulatory compliance, and fostering global relationships to enhance growth opportunities.

The company aims to leverage technology to enhance trading efficiency and provide an exceptional user experience. By investing in advanced technological platforms and infrastructure, the company seeks to streamline trading processes, thereby facilitating quicker and more secure transactions across its markets. Digitalization forms a key pillar in the company’s strategy, ensuring that the company remains competitive amid evolving market dynamics.

In addition to strengthening its core operations, the company actively pursues strategic partnerships and acquisitions to expand its market footprint and enhance its product offerings. By collaborating with international exchanges and financial institutions, the company aims to broaden its scope and provide access to a wider array of global investor bases.

Products and Services

The company offers a diverse range of products and services designed to meet the complete needs of its clients and market participants. The comprehensive offerings include:

Equities and Fundraising Services: The company organizes initial public offerings (IPOs) and facilitates secondary listings, enabling companies to raise capital effectively. The company provides a platform for trading shares, allowing individuals, institutions, and fund managers to buy and sell equity securities.

Derivatives Products: The company provides a comprehensive array of derivatives, including index futures and options, stock options, and commodity futures.

Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs): The company offers various ETFs, providing investors with a cost-effective way to gain exposure to a diversified portfolio of assets.

Fixed Income Products: Through its platforms, the company enables the trading of bonds, including government, corporate, and municipal securities. The fixed income products cater to investors seeking stable returns and portfolio diversification.

Commodities Trading: The company provides market platforms that facilitate trading in various commodities, including metals, energy products, and agricultural products.

Market Data Services: The company offers market data and information services, providing critical insights into trading volumes, price movements, and market trends.

Clearing & Settlement Services: The company ensures that all listed products are settled and cleared efficiently. The company provides essential custodial services, managing the clearing and settlement of trades to mitigate risks associated with counterparty defaults.

Corporate Services: The company offers a range of services for listed companies, including corporate governance solutions, compliance advisory, and listing support.

Geographical Markets Served

The company primarily serves the Hong Kong region but also has a strong international presence. The geographical scope of its operations extends to Asia-Pacific and other global markets, driven by a commitment to becoming a leading international exchange.

Seasonality

The operational activities of the company may exhibit seasonal tendencies, influenced by market cycles, investor behavior, and global economic conditions. Variability in trading volumes can typically be observed during different months, as investor activities may change based on market trends and fiscal year-end periods for various companies.

The company monitors seasonality patterns to better prepare for shifts in trading activities, ensuring that its operational strategies align with investor needs and market dynamics throughout the year.

Customers

The company serves a diverse array of customers, spanning various categories such as institutional investors, individual retail investors, hedge funds, asset managers, and market makers.

Sales and Marketing

The company employs multiple marketing and distribution strategies to reach its target audience effectively. Channels include digital marketing, investor education programs, and strategic partnerships with financial institutions to enhance visibility in local and global marketplaces.

Collaborative marketing efforts often consist of organizing conferences, workshops, and webinars that facilitate engagement with investors and stakeholders. The company recognizes the importance of leveraging both traditional and digital platforms to connect with a diverse audience efficiently.

History

Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited was incorporated in 1999.
records.Business Description: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited, together with its subsidiaries, owns and operates stock and futures exchanges, and related clearing houses in Hong Kong, the United Kingdom, and Mainland China. It operates through Cash, Equity and Financial Derivatives, Commodities, and Data and Connectivity segments. The Cash segment covers various equity products traded on the cash market platforms of the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited, as well as through the Shanghai-Hong Kong and the Shenzhen-Hong Kong stock connects; clearing, settlement and custodian, listing, depository, and nominee services; and other related activities. Its Equity and Financial Derivatives segment provides and maintains trading and clearing platforms for a range of equity and financial derivative products, such as stock and equity index futures and options, derivative warrants, callable bull/bear contracts and warrants, and over the counter derivatives contracts. The Commodities segment operates an exchange for the trading of base and ferrous metals futures and options contracts in the United Kingdom; and operates Qianhai Mercantile Exchange Co., Ltd., a commodity trading platform in Mainland China. This segment also covers commodities contracts traded on Futures Exchange. Its Data and Connectivity segment offers various services that provides access to the platform and infrastructure, as well as services of BayConnect Technology Company Limited; network, terminal user, data line and software sublicense, and hosting services; and sells market data relating to the Hong Kong cash and derivatives markets. The company serves issuers and investors. Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Central, Hong Kong.

records.Short Business Description: Hoops Scouting USA engages in the business of scouting high school and college basketball players in the United States.
records.Long Business Description:
Hoops Scouting USA offers a basketball website for high school basketball players with aspirations of playing post-secondary basketball.

The company’s website, www.hoopsscoutingusa.com (the ‘Website’), will be the main hub, and the company is developing an app that will work in unison with the Website.

The company is in the development stage.

Products and Products Description

The company is also an avenue for smaller university coaches, who do not have the means to recruit larger areas of the United States, and internationally.

The company will allow high school players to set up accounts, which include game film, schedules for high school and AAU games, stats, and high school academic marks. This will allow coaches to be able to see players and their stats, and can plan their recruiting with the team schedules. This brings international recruiting to the desk of every college coach in the United States, from Division 1, Division 2, Divisions 3, NAIA, and Junior College.

This platform also allows players from Europe, Australia, Asia, and South America to pursue opportunities in the United States, to schools that would normally not be able to recruit in such a wide range. Many of the larger schools with bigger recruiting budgets are often the only ones to be able to see these international players. Often, only the top players get a chance, and the second and third tier players do not get a chance to be recruited. This will all change with the company.

The Website will be the main hub, but being able to upload stats and game film directly from a smart phone will allow players and coaches to get almost immediate information. Development of an app to allow this will eventually work in unison with the Website.

The company is planning to offer basketball merchandise, including sweaters, jerseys, and shorts for sale on its Website. The company has obtained some inventory, but the online store is not yet active.

In furtherance of the company’s business plan, on February 17, 2023, the company entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement with Grit Performance Athletics Inc. (‘Grit Performance’) to acquire all right, title, and interest of Grit Performance and its Affiliates in the Grit Mobile Application, and related products, including Website, Instagram account, etc. (the ‘Assets’).

The Grit app is an on-demand digital training platform. It is designed for high level on and off court training for the serious athlete. The app was designed by professionals with over 30 years of experience in training, who have coached some of the best athletes in the world. The app is designed to make training easier and allows users to train more efficiently.

Grit App was developed for young players to train on their own anywhere, anytime, and be able to do the drills that the best professionals in the world work on during their off-season training. Basketball has risen to the second most popular sport in the world. Players in the NBA are now coming from many international countries, and people all over the world want to train like the NBA players do. Not everyone has access to pro trainers. The Grit App brings athletes closer than ever to working with top players and trainers.

Grit App

The app provides high level on and off court training for the relentless, designed by professionals. GRIT was created to help eliminate the guesswork from training. Users can follow custom workout plans, or build their own, featuring workout segments daily, created for each user’s needs and level to take their game to the next level. Everything is designed to be done on your own (or with a partner). All that is needed is a basketball, a hoop, a device to view the app, and a work ethic. The company’s coaching staff has worked with, and coached (professionally), some of the best athletes in the world, and has experience working with athletes of all ages and skill levels across the globe. All workouts contain drill videos from the company’s 1,000+ drill library in high resolution. Each drill has a tangible goal, tracking reps or time to complete, and is recorded right in the app so users can see if they are tangibly improving.

The Grit App will operate seamlessly with the company, and be able to market to all Hoops Scouting USA users, and give them a deal on training, or build packages that give them access to the company and the app for a single package price.

Grit App offers THE DAILY GRIND: GRIT + PREMIUM ZONE – a one-stop shop for the modern driven athlete. Daily workout segments for custom programming tailored to exact needs, comprehensive workout plans for specific improvement, inspiration, articles, videos, knowledge, discounts on GRIT products, strength & conditioning, and more. Designed, created, managed, and updated daily by professional coaches, trainers, and athletes.

The Grit App has the option for users to sign up for monthly or yearly programs, plus purchase individual workout plans, which they have lifetime access to. These levels are phased, and encourage users to purchase the next progression of that portion of the app to enjoy 70+ workouts and workout segments, with new workouts added daily.

The company offers the following inside the app, in addition to the video form workouts: free daily professionally programmed workouts (skill development, shooting, ball handling, athletic development, power, strength, mobility, and yoga/injury prevention), informative premium content (advice, tips, basketball IQ, sports psychology, etc.), film breakdown, interviews, live Zoom Q&A, support from the company’s staff of professional coaches and athletes from across the world via messages in the app, coaching insight, and basketball IQ seminars and tips.

The company will continue to focus on basketball scouting services. The acquisition of the Grit App allows the company to offer a separate product for those using the company app, as well as having a separate revenue stream of people using the app only. The company thinks it can use both products as separate entities, as well as advertise each through each other.

Customers

The Grit App currently has 3,500 customers. The company’s principal customers are youth to professional athletes globally; there is something for all levels inside the app. Beginners to advanced segments and drills are housed inside the app. The guesswork is taken out for athletes who choose to follow workout plans, or to combine workout segments to fully customize their workouts.

Marketing

The company plans to market its products through the following methods: (i) the company’s Website, (ii) search engine optimization, (iii) social networking websites, (iv) printing, mailing, and emailing catalogues and flyers to potential customers, (v) word of mouth, (vi) telephoning potential customers, (vii) content marketing, and (viii) paid ads. The company hopes to have repeat customers coming and buying new products online from its Website.

The Grit App can take on advertisers, which can be put on all user and franchisee pages of the app. The company plans to use NBA, NCAA, and other professional, as well as the world’s top trainers, to help advertise the app. The profit share structure the company plans to implement allows these players to advertise via social media, and share in users’ profits.

History

Hoops Scouting USA was founded in 2016. The company was incorporated in 2016 under the laws of the State of Wyoming.
