records.Long Business Description:
Yelp Inc. (‘Yelp’) provide scalable services across platforms and devices using a combination of proprietary, open source and third-party technology solutions and products.

The company has built one of the best-known Internet brands in the United States. Consumers trust the company for the more than 300 million ratings and reviews available on its platform of businesses across a broad range of categories. The company’s advertising products help businesses of all sizes reach a large audience, advertise their products, and drive conversion of their services, while its subscription services support businesses operationally.

Growth Strategy

The company’s strategies are to take initiatives to drive durable, long-term growth, which includes reconceiving Yelp around actions and answers, delivering AI tools that help businesses grow, operate, and succeed, and extending its reach to power local discovery across the AI ecosystem; investing in high-return areas to drive profitable growth; and capitalizing on the opportunities ahead, and increasing spend on paid traffic acquisition.

Products and Services

Advertising

The company offers a range of free and paid advertising products to businesses of all sizes, including the products listed below, which provide the ability to deliver targeted advertising to the company’s large and high-intent audience. As in past years, advertising accounted for the vast majority of its revenue during the year ended December 31, 2025, contributing 95% of its revenue. The company recognizes revenue from its business listing and advertising products, including advertising sold by partners, as advertising revenue.

Advertising Products

CPC Advertising (‘Yelp Ads’): The company allows businesses to promote themselves in sponsored search results on its platform, on the Yelp pages of businesses in the same or related categories, and in other key locations on its platform. Yelp Ads can also be delivered through syndication on the Yelp Ads Network, a large collection of third-party sites. The company primarily sells performance-based ads, which its advertising platform matches to individual consumers through its automated auction system priced on a CPC basis. The company generates a majority of its advertising revenue from the sale of CPC advertising. It also provides Services businesses with the ability to provide competing quotes for consumers using the company’s Request-a-Quote feature.

Multi-location Ad Products: The company offers a range of ad products designed for multi-location advertisers, including: Showcase Ads, which showcase and feature limited-time offers, new products or promotions in relevant search results; Spotlight Ads, which highlight special offers and promotions related to seasonal or other special events on Yelp business pages in a prominent carousel directly on the Yelp app home screen; and Yelp Audiences, which extends campaign reach to the company’s high-intent audience off-platform on third-party sites and apps. The company also offers first-party attribution solutions: Yelp Store Visits, which provides insights on how Yelp Ads drive physical store foot traffic, and a conversion API, which allows advertisers the ability to share their marketing data with Yelp to more accurately measure the effectiveness of their advertising spend.

Yelp Connect: Yelp Connect provides advertisers with a channel to market new offerings, such as new menu items and specials, or communicate business updates to customers. Yelp Connect posts appear in various locations on the company’s platform, including business pages and the home feed on its mobile apps.

Nearby Jobs: Nearby Jobs provides businesses with the ability to see a dynamic feed of job quote requests in their area of business.

Yelp Guaranteed: Yelp Guaranteed is a satisfaction guarantee program that provides limited coverage to consumers who hire a Yelp Guaranteed business through Request-a-Quote, in the event something goes wrong with their projects. It is currently available for eligible businesses in select Services categories that have Request-a-Quote enabled and are using Yelp Ads, as well as businesses that are hired through Yelp Assistant that have Yelp Ads.

RepairPal Network: The RepairPal marketplace and partner network promote auto repair shops to consumers searching for auto repair services. Auto repair shops pay a monthly fee to be included in this certified shop network, as well as either a percentage of earnings from repair orders made by referred customers, or a fixed fee per referred customer.

Business Page Products

Free Business Account: Businesses have the ability to create a free business account and claim a Yelp business page for each of their business locations. Once a business has claimed its page, it can more easily update its listing information and has the option to purchase certain page upgrade features.

Upgrade Package: The company’s most popular product after Yelp Ads is its Upgrade Package, which includes access to features such as the removal of competitor ads from the business’s Yelp page, Business Highlights, Portfolio, Yelp Connect, and Logo, among other features.

Branded Profile: The company’s Branded Profile is a multi-location product that provides businesses with access to premium features in connection with their Yelp business pages, such as the ability to update listing information and select photos to highlight on the page through a slideshow feature.

Enhanced Profile: In addition to providing multi-location businesses with the same premium features and support options as the company’s Branded Profile product, its Enhanced Profile product prevents ads from other businesses from appearing on the Yelp business pages of its Enhanced Profile customers.

Verified License: Verified License is a badge that appears on Yelp business pages as a paid upgrade for certain eligible licensed businesses, primarily in the company’s Home and Local Services categories. The badge indicates that the company has verified the business’s trade license and confirmed it was in good standing as of a certain date, allowing businesses to distinguish themselves as licensed and helping consumers make confident decisions when selecting businesses for their projects.

Business Highlights: Businesses in eligible categories can pay to highlight up to six attributes that make their business unique, such as ‘Family Owned’ or ‘Pet Friendly.’

Portfolio: Portfolio allows businesses to showcase their work or services to prospective customers through a collection of projects.

Logo: Logo provides businesses with the ability to display their logos in high-visibility locations, including prominently at the top of Yelp business pages and in search results.

Other: The company generates other revenue through subscription services, licensing payments for access to Yelp data, transactions, and other non-advertising arrangements.

Yelp Guest Manager: Yelp Guest Manager is a subscription-based suite of front-of-house management tools for restaurants, nightlife, and certain other venues. These tools include online reservations, a waitlist management solution that allows consumers to check wait times and join waitlists remotely, as well as through hostless kiosks, and seating and server rotation management tools.

Yelp Host and Yelp Receptionist: Yelp Host and Yelp Receptionist are AI-powered phone assistants for restaurants and service pros, respectively. Yelp Host includes features such as answering calls, managing reservations, sharing wait times, texting links to guests for takeout orders, answering questions, and more. Yelp Receptionist asks nuanced questions to capture important project details, vetting and helping qualify new leads, and collecting information needed to provide an accurate quote or schedule a consultation or appointment.

records.Short Business Description: Yimutian Inc., through its subsidiaries, provides agricultural B2B platform services for agricultural product transaction in the People’s Republic of China.
records.Long Business Description:
Yimutian Inc. is an agricultural B2B platform in mainland China.

The company is dedicated to digitalizing China’s agricultural product supply chain infrastructure to streamline the agricultural product transaction process, making it efficient, transparent, secure, and convenient. Riding on the wave of agri-tech upgrade and leveraging the company’s profound industry experience and accumulated market insights, the company provides a comprehensive set of digital solutions to facilitate agricultural product transactions, ranging from searching, matching, to transaction facilitation and settlement. Additionally, leveraging the company’s industry experience and market insights, the company has ventured into the realm of smart farming and agricultural sourcing and trading, further broadening the company’s commercialization channels and animating the company’s other business lines.

The company prides itself as the go-to platform for merchants by leveraging the company’s innovative technology and industry know-how. Technological capabilities run in the company’s genes ever since the company commenced its operations. The company’s proprietary agricultural algorithm, being accurate and efficient to sort out matching problems amongst buyers, sellers and massive SKUs, processes terabytes of information daily. Leveraging such insights, the company is able to constantly improve accuracy in transaction matching and facilitate the company’s decision-making in conducting the company’s new business venture including agricultural trading and sourcing and smart farming. The company continues to pioneer innovation in the industry through expanding into broader areas of AI-powered applications to enhance merchants’ experience and streamline operations. For example, the company utilizes natural language processing technologies adapted from open-source models to enhance the efficiency of collecting supply information from sellers, which elevates user experience on the company’s platform. The company is also developing an AI-powered customer service system, which leverages the capabilities of third-party large language model. This model is instrumental in promptly acquiring insights into merchant demand through chat interactions, thereby enhancing the company’s efficiency in transaction matching. The company’s insightful, accurate and up-to-date market quotation database, being the other building block of the company’s success formula, is backed by the company’s dedicated R&D team. The company’s large number of daily active merchants, acting with diverse characteristics and online behaviors, provide daily feedback and response in real time, which allows the company to continually enrich the quotation database, extend the depth and breadth of the company’s knowledge graph, amass the collective intelligence, and harness the power of technology.

The company has achieved at-scale commercialization and have a track record of proven success. The company’s platform had over 38 million merchants as of December 31, 2024. In 2024, the company’s platform facilitated approximately 147 million searches, 583 million calls and instant messages, and over 187 million potential transactions. As of December 31, 2024, the merchants presented approximately 21 million SKUs on the company’s platform. Building upon the company’s experience in transaction matching since the company’s inception, the company connected over 770,000 sellers and over 6 million buyers in 2024 in the agricultural product supply chain with precise, dynamic and up-to-date information related to agricultural product transactions. The company further elevates merchant experiences with a full spectrum of services in advertising and client contact privilege by providing the merchants with a suite of online tools. As of December 31, 2024, the company’s geographic footprint covered over 340 cities and 2,800 counties, representing over 65% of the primary and secondary agricultural wholesale markets in mainland China. The company further entered into the agricultural sourcing and trading business in 2024, broadening procurement channels and sales channels for regional buyers and local agricultural producers and processors, respectively, and facilitating sales with reliable, real-time market information and consistent quality and timely deliveries, achieving greater transaction efficiency in the upstream of the agricultural product supply chain and leading to increased repeat purchases. As of the date of this prospectus, the company has established 12 offline stores in mainland China to trade agricultural products at cultivation and production sites with sellers and buyers.

The success of the company’s business is underpinned by the following main business lines:

Digital Agricultural Commerce Services. The company’s digital agricultural commerce services are mainly offered via Yimutian App, complemented by sales-assistance services offered via Douniu App. Launched in 2015, Yimutian App is a versatile, merchant-friendly B2B e-commerce platform designated for sellers from agricultural production bases or factories and buyers scattered in the country. With distinct functions, Yimutian App is the front line of the company’s online traffic attraction to facilitate modular product posting, portray merchant profiles and distribute information to complete the transaction matching. To complement the agricultural e-commerce business and address the downstream need of agricultural product transaction on the wholesale level, the company offers agricultural product sales-assistance services which connect sellers with wholesale stallholders via Douniu App. It complements Yimutian App with first-hand market information from the offline transactions and refines the company’s omni-channel in reaching the great majority of fragmented merchants groups. The company mainly monetizes its digital agricultural commerce services through membership services, value-added services and transaction services.

Agricultural Sourcing and Trading Services. In 2024, the company launched a new business venture — agricultural sourcing and trading — to penetrate deeper in the supply chain under the brand name ‘Wolaicai,’ which phonetically resembles ‘I purchase for you’ in Chinese. Through the agricultural sourcing and training business, the company positions itself as brokers of agricultural products and directly make the deal and procure agricultural products from cultivation and production sites for buyers with regional or bulk procurement capacities, achieving greater transaction efficiency in the upstream of the agricultural product supply chain. The company’s value proposition for this business line is to provide consistently high quality pre-sale and post-sale services for buyers of agricultural products. The company primarily monetizes this business by completing transactions with buyers and sellers through the company’s sales representatives at offline stores.

Smart Farming. Drawing on knowledge and resources the company accumulated from years of providing digital agricultural commerce services, the company launched its smart farming business in 2023 through collaboration with local business partners to selectively cultivate produce based on market demand.

The company strategically selects produce that are cultivated in limited regions during a short window of the year but with strong economic potential, and strategically plant these produce in production region and during cultivation season that complement its original production region and cultivation season. After successful trial planting of a selected produce, the company commences large-scale production applying innovative cultivation technologies and subsequently promote and sell these products to agricultural buyers with regional or bulk procurement capacities, wholesalers and merchants online and offline through the company’s digital agricultural commerce services. records.Long Business Description:
Yinhang Internet Technologies Development, Inc. operates an online marketplace that serves merchants and consumers in China, which enables them to connect, share information, and conduct business.

The company’s three variable interest entities include Beijing Huashangjie Electronic Business Service Co. Ltd. (Huashangjie); Beijing UKT Investment Management Co. Ltd. (UKT); Beijing Qianxian Media Advertising Co. Ltd. (Qianxian Media).

Huashangjie

Huashangjie offers classified information platform services, which enable local merchants and consumers in China to connect, share information, and conduct business through its ‘3ghuashang.com’ and ‘HS.cn’ Website and mobile devices. Huashangjie provides platform-hosting services to end users who advertise their products on its Website. The end users are solicited through independent sales agents of Huashangjie. The agents solicit end users, merchants and individuals, in designated territories to advertise their products and services on Huashangjie’s Website. The sales agents are Huashangjie’s customers and they pay a fee to Huashangjie for the right to recruit end users. The fees paid by the agents to Huashangjie are determined by negotiation between them and do not necessarily correlate to the fees the agents receive from end users, which are determined by negotiation between the agents and the end users.

Huashangjie has 170,000 registered members and approximately 8,000 sales agents.

Huashangjie’s online marketplace contains local information in approximately 34 provinces, including approximately 8000 counties, across various content categories. The Huishang E station solves the bottleneck of online platforms by integrating services onto a device and alerting local processors to a customer’s wants.

records.Short Business Description: Zagrebacka burza d.d. engages in the management of the regulated market in Croatia and Slovenia.
records.Long Business Description:
Zagrebacka burza d.d. is operating primarily as a stock exchange. Its primary business includes facilitating the buying and selling of securities, offering a platform for quoting, trading, and maintaining the liquidity of financial instruments. The company plays a critical role in the capital markets, providing listing services for companies and acting as an intermediary between buyers and sellers. The company is responsible for the establishment of regulatory policies to ensure fair trading practices, maintaining transparency in transaction processes, and safeguarding investor interests.

The company’s operational focus encompasses several key dimensions, including but not limited to the collection of commissions from trading activities, maintenance fees for recorded securities, and membership fees from market participants. By operating in line with strict regulatory frameworks, the company ensures compliance with local and international financial standards. 

Business Segments

The company operates within distinct geographical segments primarily identified as Croatia and Slovenia.

Croatia

This segment represents its core segment, given that the company originated there, and it operates the Croatian financial market. This segment contributes a substantial share of the company's revenues, primarily through trading commissions, listing fees, and ancillary services offered to local investors and corporations.

Slovenia

This segment serves as an extension of the company’s operations into neighboring markets. By expanding into Slovenia, the company addresses the growing need for accessible trading platforms and financial services across the region. The promotional efforts in this segment include strategic marketing, partnerships, and providing value-added services aimed at increasing trading volume and attracting new market participants.

Both segments are crucial in shaping the company’s comprehensive service offerings, such as the listing of private and public corporate securities, management of securities issuance, and providing up-to-date financial information and analyses to investors. Beyond geographical segmentation, the company also segments its services into various categories, including equity trading, debt securities, derivatives, and other complex financial instruments. This segmentation allows the company to tailor its offerings to the specific needs of different financial entities, broadening its appeal to a diverse set of clientele, from institutional investors to retail traders.

Strategy

The company pursues a multifaceted business strategy aimed at sustaining its leadership in the financial services sector while expanding its market presence. Central to this strategy is the commitment to enhance customer experience through technology-driven solutions. Investments in advanced trading platforms reflect the company's intention to streamline transaction processes, reduce costs, and provide real-time access to market data. This approach not only maximizes operational efficiency but also fosters greater investor confidence and participation.

Another strategic pillar includes the continuous development of competitive listing services aimed at attracting both domestic and international companies to list their securities on the exchange. The company actively promotes the benefits of listing, such as increased visibility, market credibility, and access to capital, thus establishing a diverse array of investment opportunities for market participants. 

The company also emphasizes strong regulatory compliance and governance practices, ensuring that all operations meet high standards of integrity. This commitment is pivotal for maintaining investor confidence and ensuring sustained participation in capital markets.

Additionally, targeted marketing strategies are executed to elevate brand visibility and educate potential investors about the value propositions offered. Joint ventures and strategic partnerships are explored, enhancing market reach and complementing core services. Such alliances create a synergistic effect that expands the company’s ability to provide comprehensive financial services tailored to market requirements.

Products and Services

The company's product offerings and services are extensive and designed to cater to a diverse clientele. The primary offerings include trading services for equities, fixed income, and derivatives. As the primary marketplace in Croatia, the company provides a platform where buyers and sellers can engage in transactions in a regulated and transparent environment.

Trade services encompass various functions such as order execution, clearing, and settlement. The company has developed advanced trading technology that allows for efficient transactions, significantly improving the speed at which trades are executed. Furthermore, the company aids in listing securities for companies, offering comprehensive support throughout the process, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements.

The company also offers quotation and maintenance services for listed securities, which requires ongoing monitoring and compliance assurance. This service assists issuers in ensuring that their securities remain listed on the Exchange and retain visibility in the market, thus nurturing investor confidence.

In addition, the company conducts market data services, providing valuable information to investors and traders about market performance, histories, and forecasts. This data not only enhances investment decision-making but also supports a range of analytics requirements across the financial services industry.

Membership services offer a range of benefits, including access to trading services, market analysis, and specialized support tailored to institutional investors. The company engages in educational initiatives aimed at bolstering financial literacy among retail investors, thereby promoting more informed trading practices.

Geographical Markets Served

The company primarily serves the Croatian and Slovenian markets, having established a significant presence in both regions. Within Croatia, it serves a wide array of institutional investors, brokerage firms, and retail investors, thus acting as a vital conduit for accessing the financial markets. In Slovenia, the company captures market opportunities centered on fostering cross-border trading relationships and facilitating the entry of foreign entities seeking to engage with the local market.

Through this geographical diversification, the company not only mitigates risks associated with market fluctuations in any single region but also leverages cross-market opportunities that emerge from increased trade and investment activities.

Seasonality

Seasonal fluctuations have a minimal impact on the company’s operations significantly. The financial services sector tends to maintain steady transactional activities throughout the year; however, some minor variations are observed during specific market events, holidays, and end-of-year financial periods. The company remains resilient to typical market cycles and optimally positions itself to capitalize on any arising opportunities through targeted strategies that insulate revenues from these fluctuations.

Customers

The company services a wide variety of customer categories, including retail investors, institutional investors, brokerage firms, and corporations seeking to list their securities. This diverse clientele ensures a robust participation base in trading activities across the exchange.

The total number of customers served encompasses several entities, with the focus on maintaining strong relationships across all categories. Active engagement and fostering of customer loyalty through tailored services are fundamental aspects of the company's operational ethos.

records.Short Business Description: Zedge, Inc. builds digital marketplaces and competitive games around content that people use to express themselves.
records.Long Business Description:
Zedge, Inc. (Zedge) builds digital marketplaces and competitive games around content that people use to express themselves.

The company’s products include Zedge Ringtones and Wallpapers, which it refers to as the company’s ‘Zedge App,’ a freemium digital content marketplace offering mobile phone wallpapers, video wallpapers, ringtones, and notification sounds as well as pAInt, a generative AI wallpaper maker, GuruShots, a skill-based photo challenge game, and Emojipedia, the trusted source for ‘all things emoji’.

The company’s Zedge App (which is named ‘Zedge Wallpapers’ in the App Store) offers a wide array of mobile personalization content, including wallpapers, video wallpapers, ringtones, and notification sounds, and is available both in Google Play and the App Store. MAU is a key performance indicator (‘KPI’) for the company’s Zedge App that captures the number of unique users that used its Zedge App during the final 30 days of the relevant period. The company’s platform allows creators to upload content to its marketplace and avail it to the company’s users either for free or, via ‘Zedge Premium,’ the section of its marketplace where the company offers premium content for purchase. In turn, the company’s users utilize the content to personalize their phones and express their individuality.

In 2023, the company introduced pAInt, a generative AI wallpaper maker in the Zedge App. A generative AI wallpaper maker is an implementation of artificial intelligence software that can create images from text descriptions. In addition, the company upgraded Zedge+, its paid subscription offering by bundling together an ad-free experience with value adds making the offering more compelling.

The company often refers to its freemium ringtones and wallpapers, the company’s subscription offering, the functionality for creators to market their products and ancillary offering and features both in its Zedge App and website, as the company’s Zedge Marketplace.

The Zedge Marketplace’s monetization stack consists of advertising revenue generated when users view advertisements when using the Zedge App (and the related functionality under the zedge.net website), the in-app sale of Zedge Credits, the company’s virtual currency, that is used to purchase Zedge Premium content, and a paid-subscription offering that provides an ad-free experience to users that purchase a monthly or annual subscription. In April 2023, the company introduced a subscription tier in the iOS version of the app. As of July 31, 2024, the company had approximately 669,0000 active subscribers.

The company owns GuruShots Ltd (‘GuruShots’) a recognized category leader focused on gamifying the photography vertical. GuruShots offers a platform spanning iOS, Android, and the web that provides a fun, educational and structured way for amateur photographers to compete in a wide variety of contests showcasing their photos while gaining recognition with votes, badges, and awards.

GuruShots utilizes a ‘Free-to-Play’ business model and generates revenue through in-app purchases of virtual currency. Players can use this currency to unlock competitions or gain an edge by purchasing resources and participating in additional gameplay.

In fiscal 2024, the company revamped GuruShots’ customer onboarding experience by guiding new players through simplified photo competitions of limited size and duration. The upgrade was designed to enhance the gaming experience for new players by increasing their potential for winning and providing immediate gratification.

The company markets GuruShots to prospective players, primarily via paid user acquisition channels, and utilize a host of creative formats, including static and video ads to promote the game. The company’s marketing team invests material resources in analyzing all attributes of a campaign ranging from, among others, the creative assets, offer acquisition channel and platform (i.e., iOS, Android, and web), with the goal of determining whether a specific campaign is likely to yield a profitable customer. When the company unearths a successful combination of these variables it scales up until the company experience diminishing returns. Ultimately, the efforts it is making to advance the product coupled with the investment in user acquisition can significantly increase GuruShots’ player base.

In addition, the company is benefitting from the experience that the GuruShots team possesses in gamifying the Zedge App. One example is the company’s hybrid casual title, ‘AI Art Master,’ which has been in soft-launch in the Philippines, Poland, and India, that enables players to create generative AI images and compete in themed-based competitions with these images.

The company owns Emojipedia Pty Ltd (‘Emojipedia’), the authority dedicated to providing up-to-date and well-researched emoji definitions, information, and news, as well as World Emoji Day and the annual World Emoji Awards. In July 2024, Emojipedia received approximately 37.6 million monthly page views and has approximately 9.6 million monthly active users as of July 31, 2024, of which approximately 46.7% are in well-developed markets. It is the top resource for all things emoji, offering insights into data and cultural trends. As a member of the Unicode Consortium, the standards body responsible for approving new emojis, Emojipedia works alongside major emoji creators, including Apple, Google, Meta, and X, formerly known as Twitter.

Strategic Flywheel

The company’s long-term strategy calls for creating and supporting a flywheel that leverages the synergies of content creation, gaming and marketplaces by empowering consumers with easy-to-use content creation utilities whose output can be used to engage across a multitude of online and mobile platforms, including social networks, messaging, and gaming as well as for commerce purposes. This is unlike the existing dynamic that many gaming platforms offer to players, who can create and sell virtual goods that are valuable only within the context of that ecosystem. Although the foundation of the company’s strategy is centered around the Zedge Marketplace and GuruShots, over time it expects to expand into other content verticals that has relevance beyond gameplay.

Using the company’s products as an example, GuruShots is a skill-based game that attracts creators (mainly, amateur photographers) with friendly photo competitions in which they compete to gain recognition and pedigree.

Technology

The company’s ecosystem is powered by a scalable distributed platform that comprises both open source and proprietary technologies centered on content management and discovery, web and app development, data science and analytics, deep learning, mobile content/device compatibility, advertising/marketing tech, and reporting. The company has built a robust platform that allows it to ideate, test, analyze, and launch where warranted by the outcome. The company enhanced its users’ content creation options with generative AI models, the company embraced machine learning, including AI and LLM throughout its technology stack to improve content recommendations and relevancy. From an end user’s perspective, the company’s platform minimizes response latency while focuses on key areas, including content creation, relevancy and discoverability. The company optimizes its platform by utilizing systems, algorithms, and heuristics that organize its content based on real user data, and that renders the content in a relevant fashion. The company focuses on delivering the highest quality content to users while minimizing its infrastructure costs on used bandwidth. With GuruShots, the company has added open source and proprietary technologies around gamification, including ranking algorithms that ensure fair exposure to all content in a competition, real-time voting/ranking functionality at scale, and a personal competition recommendations system based on users

records.Short Business Description: Zero2IPO Holdings Inc., an investment holding company, provides integrated equity investment services in the People’s Republic of China.
records.Long Business Description:
Zero2IPO Holdings Inc. serves as an integrated service platform for the equity investment industry, offering an array of services including data, marketing, investment banking, and training to various stakeholders in the equity investment sector.

Business Segments

operates through several key business segments tailored to meet the diverse needs of stakeholders in the equity investment industry:

Data Services: This segment provides seamless access to industry data through the proprietary PEdata Database and PEDATA MAX, supporting informed decision-making for investors, entrepreneurs, and governmental agencies. Customized reports enhance clients’ strategic decision-making processes.

Marketing Services: This segment offering omni-channel marketing through platforms like PEdaily and offline industry events, the company provides high-quality content and networking opportunities, facilitating collaboration and insights among industry participants.

Investment Banking Services: This segment connects early-stage entrepreneurs with investors via the online matching platform Deal-Market and provides offline support to capture financing opportunities during growth phases.

Training Services: The company offers various training programs to enhance the skills and knowledge of participants in the equity investment landscape, recognizing the importance of education in the sector.

These integrated segments enhance the overall service offering, helping THE COMPANY maintain its competitive edge in the marketplace.

Business Strategy

The company has established a robust business strategy that focuses on growth and improvement within its core operational framework.

The company is committed to enhancing its service offerings, utilizing advanced technologies like artificial intelligence (AI) to innovate and streamline its processes. The introduction of AI-generated content into the PEDATA MAX platform is a testament to its initiative to leverage technology for better customer service and engagement.

The company places significant emphasis on market expansion, particularly in Hong Kong, which is viewed as a growth driver to enhance its market presence further.

The company continuously evaluates market trends to adapt its strategies effectively in alignment with evolving customer needs and industry dynamics. The strategic focus on data services also aligns with the growing demand for analytics and data-driven insights among investors and businesses.

Products and Services

The company provides a diverse range of products and services for the equity investment industry, including:

PEdata Database: The company comprehensive data repository that helps users make informed investment decisions, continuously updated for accuracy and relevance.

PEDATA MAX: An advanced SaaS-based version of the PEdata Database, offering multi-dimensional data from China’s equity investment market for timely and thorough professional data services.

Customized Reports: Tailored reports that support strategic decision-making processes for clients.

Marketing Services Platforms: The company Including PEdaily, which aggregates industry content and offers advertising opportunities, serving a wide range of notable enterprises.

Offline Events: Significant industry events organized for networking, relationship building, and knowledge sharing among market participants.

Training Programs: Comprehensive training services that enhance industry knowledge and equip clients with necessary skills for navigating the equity investment landscape.

The company is dedicated to supporting client growth and success in a competitive environment.

Geographical Markets Served

The company mainly operates in the People's Republic of China, where it has structured its services to cater to a vast array of clients involved in the equity investment sector. The focus on the Chinese market, particularly in urban centers and economic hubs, reflects the company's strategy to capitalize on the rapid growth within this industry. In addition, its burgeoning efforts in Hong Kong are expected to further bolster the company's geographical footprint and PESC.

Seasonality

The company recognizes that market dynamics and investment behaviors can exhibit seasonal trends. As a player in the equity investment industry, the fluctuations in activity levels could align with broader economic cycles and periods of heightened market engagement.

Customers

The company serves a diverse clientele that includes individual investors, growth companies, and government agencies within the equity investment sector. The company extensive product suite and user engagement suggest a broad customer base across various categories within the industry.

Sales and Marketing

The company utilizes a dual method of sales and marketing through both online and offline channels. The marketing strategy encompasses omni-channel approaches by providing content through digital platforms while also hosting physical industry events to foster networking and collaboration. By leveraging digital channels that attract large user engagement, the company can maintain a presence in the market and connect effectively with a varied clientele.

History

Zero2IPO Holdings Inc. was founded in 2001. The company was incorporated in 2019.

records.Short Business Description: Zhihu Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates an online content community in the People’s Republic of China.
records.Long Business Description:
Zhihu Inc. (Zhihu) operates an online content community in the People's Republic of China.

On Zhihu, the company’s users explore and enjoy content that broadens horizons, provides solutions, and resonates with minds, ranging from daily life choices such as purchasing a television or a mobile phone, choosing an inspirational holiday hide-away, a puzzle book, or a reality show, to sophisticated knowledge or unique experience such as learning about the latest generative AI technology or discussing about the research topics of Nobel Prize laureates. The company’s content also addresses life decisions, such as selecting a college or a good exam preparation program, making career choices, managing a relationship, or expecting a baby. A full spectrum of high-quality content on Zhihu appeals to an ever-growing user base and content creators, who have come to Zhihu to share their knowledge, experience, and insights. Zhihu goes beyond that first question and brings people together through their commonality.

The company launched its business in 2010, it has been dedicated to expanding its content and service offerings to meet the diverse needs of its users, content creators, and business partners. Alongside the company’s development, it has formed a content-centric business model, which continues to evolve.

The Zhihu model is centered around a virtuous cycle seeking to achieve a content equilibrium between what the company’s content creators contribute and what its users consume.

The company’s users and content creators actively interact with each other and share knowledge, experience, and insights, forming a content ecosystem spanning a wide range of verticals and topics across diverse content forms.

In 2024, the company made significant strides in exploration of AI through internal initiatives and deeper integration with Zhihu community, recognizing and harnessing its potential to unlock opportunities for its long-term growth.

In March 2024, the company launched a trial version of its AI-powered search feature, quickly earning positive feedbacks from its users. In June, the company officially introduced Zhihu Zhida, enhancing the user experience on querying, searching, and summarizing on the PC platform, followed by a Zhida tab launched on the Zhihu app in late August which further improved accessibility and functionality for users on mobile devices. In October, the company launched the ‘Professional Search’ feature within Zhihu Zhida, designed to meet the needs of academic researchers and professionals.

As of the end of 2024, both the amount of AI-related content and the number of creators in the company community have surged with double-digit year-over-year growth. Earlier in 2025, the company has thrilled to be selected by DeepSeek as the exclusive Chinese content platform to release the latest details and cost-benefit analysis of their latest open-source models.

Zhihu Content

Zhihu’s comprehensive, high-quality content is continually enriched by the company’s content creators with systematic support from its content operations, reinforcing Zhihu’s reputation as a trustworthy online content community. The company continues to foster its community culture by encouraging the creation of fulfilling content, refining the experience of the company’s users and content creators, and upgrading its technology infrastructure.

Popular categories include career development, science and engineering, art, consumer digital, movies and short stories, business and finance, mother and baby care, lifestyle and fashion, sports, and games, among others. Various distribution channels are available for users to effectively and efficiently explore the Zhihu content, such as feeds, searches, trending topics, and follows. As a comprehensive online content community, the company seeks to maintain a diverse portfolio of content offerings.

Zhihu’s content originated from a Q&A format, as that Q&A is an intuitive and efficient way to inspire and facilitate discovery, learning, discussion, and engagement. The company's continuous expansion of premium content offerings aims to unlock commercialization potential and benefit a broader audience. In May 2023, it officially launched Yanyan Story, an app dedicated to boutique short-form stories for subscribing members who prefer a dedicated and immersive reading experience. The company is also diligently expanding other premium content offerings to satisfy the demands of its expanding subscriber base, which incentivizes further growth of its subscribing members, strengthens its trustworthy brand image, and effectively contributes to the growth in paid membership revenue.

Content Operations

The Zhihu model is based on a content equilibrium between what the company's content creators contribute and what its users consume. The company's content operations rely on its overall comprehension of content through its ‘fulfilling-ness’ approach, as well as its understanding of content creators, informed by its TopicRank algorithms. Leveraging its evolving and growing technological capabilities, the company strives to maintain and enhance the fulfilling-ness and credibility of its content. The company's unique content operating approach, this ‘fulfilling-ness’ approach, combined with its TopicRank algorithms, holistically deepens its comprehension of the Zhihu content, which fuels all aspects of its business.

records.Short Business Description: Ziff Davis, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a digital media and internet company in the United States and internationally.
records.Long Business Description:
Ziff Davis, Inc. (‘Ziff Davis’), together with its subsidiaries, operates as a vertically focused digital media and internet company whose portfolio includes leading brands in technology, shopping, gaming and entertainment, health and wellness, connectivity, cybersecurity, and martech.

The company’s digital media businesses specialize in publishing and producing trusted editorial content and tools for users seeking information and advice relating to the technology, shopping, gaming and entertainment, and health and wellness markets, and offer services to consumers and businesses. The company’s connectivity business develops actionable broadband network intelligence and insights through data collection and analysis, and delivers products and services that facilitate improvements in network performance to enterprises that provide or rely on broadband networks, including, through the provision of hardware and software used for planning and assessing the performance of wi-fi networks. The company’s cybersecurity and marketing technology business provides internet-delivered, cloud-based subscription and licensed services to consumers and businesses, including, cybersecurity, privacy, and digital marketing tools.

Growth Strategy

The company, in addition to growing its business organically, regularly acquires businesses to grow its customer bases, expand and diversify its service offerings, enhance its technologies, acquire skilled personnel, and enter into new markets. The company’s systemic and repeatable M&A process allows it to execute a large volume of mergers and acquisitions (‘M&A’) with velocity and conviction.

Segments

The company’s consolidated revenues are currently generated primarily from five reportable segments: Technology & Shopping, Gaming & Entertainment, Health & Wellness, (collectively, the company’s ‘Digital Media Businesses’), Connectivity, and Cybersecurity & Martech.

The primary types of revenues that the company generates are described below.

Advertising and Performance Marketing – The company sells online display and video advertising on its owned-and-operated websites and applications, and on third-party sites. The company has contractual arrangements with advertisers either directly or through agencies. The terms of these contracts specify the price of the advertising to be sold and the volume of advertisements that will be served over the course of a campaign. Additionally, the company has contractual arrangements with certain third-party websites and applications not owned by it, and third-party advertising networks, to deliver online display and video advertising to their websites and applications, or to third-party sites. The company generates leads for advertisers, including, vendors of consumer health and wellness products, consumer packaged goods, and information technology services, through various marketing methods. The company also generates clicks to online merchants by listing products, deals, and discounts on its web properties, and earns a commission when customers ‘click-through’ the ad to make a purchase.

Subscription and Licensing – The company provides cloud-based subscription services and generates ‘fixed’ subscription revenues for customer subscriptions, and, to a lesser extent, ‘variable’ usage revenues generated from actual usage by the company’s subscribers. The company offers subscription and licensing services to businesses, which offer up-to-date insights into global fixed broadband and mobile performance data, and it offers subscription packages to consumers through the Lose It! weight loss app, and through Humble Bundle’s digital subscriptions and storefront for video games, ebooks, and software. The company also generates revenue from the sale of perpetual software licenses, related software support, and maintenance used in conjunction with software and other related services. The company licenses its proprietary technology, data, and intellectual property to third parties for various purposes.

Other – Other revenues primarily include those from the sale of hardware used in conjunction with software, online course revenues, game publishing revenues, and revenues from a customer acquisition platform for subscription services companies.

Technology & Shopping

Technology

The company’s technology platform includes online publishers, as well as tools and services tailored to consumers, professionals, and organizations looking for technological expertise, authoritativeness, and trustworthiness. The company expects its brands to deliver deeply researched, current, and authentic content related to technology, culture, and the internet. The company’s technology brands include CNET, PCMag, Mashable, Lifehacker, Spiceworks, and ZDNET.

The company’s publishing brands, including, CNET and PCMag, are online resources for laboratory-based product reviews, technology news, buying guides, and research papers. The company operates one of the longest-running independent testing facilities for consumer technology products. Founded in 1984, the company’s lab produces unbiased technology product and service reviews, and PCMag’s ‘Editor’s Choice’ award is recognized globally as a trusted mark for buyers and sellers of technology products and services. The company’s technology publishing sites are also recognized as trusted global sources of stories for more than a dozen platforms, including, Instagram, X, and Facebook.

CNET is a trusted digital media publication that provides expert information, hands-on lab testing, reviews, and analysis on consumer technologies, services, and trends, to help customers find exactly what they are looking for. For nearly 30 years, CNET has covered a wide range of topics, including, consumer electronics, smart home, money, wellness, and more.

PCMag is a leading authority on technology, delivering lab-based, independent reviews of the latest products and services. For over 40 years, its expert analysis and practical solutions have helped consumers make better buying decisions and get more from technology.

Mashable is a trusted global media brand publishing premium content for individuals interested in technology and culture. Mashable produces stories for more than a dozen platforms, including, Snapchat, X, and Facebook.

Since 2005, Lifehacker has been a go-to source for tech help and life advice. Its mission is to offer reliable tech help and credible, practical, science-based life advice to help people live better.

Spiceworks provides digital content for buyers of IT products and services, allowing IT vendors to identify, reach, and influence corporate IT decision makers who are actively researching specific IT purchases.

ZDNET is a leading tech brand for professionals, covering the innovations, trends, and products that are shaping today and tomorrow. With pragmatic wisdom and real-world experience, ZDNET connects business audiences to a better future by turning disruption and confusion into opportunity.

Shopping

The properties in the company’s shopping platform seek to influence customer purchase decisions through the provision of authoritative content relating to products and services, as well as the presentation of savings and discount opportunities for consumer shopping audiences. The company also facilitates gift card processing, program management, and marketing programs specifically tailored to meet the needs of high-growth online and app-based brands.

RetailMeNot’s promotional media solutions include mobile coupons and codes, and cash back offers across web, app, and browser extensions.

records.Short Business Description: Zonzia Media, Inc. operates as a multi-platform entertainment company in the United States.
records.Long Business Description:
Zonzia Media, Inc. operates as a multi-platform entertainment distribution company.

The company focuses on delivering content with the objective of generating both advertising revenue and subscription revenue. The company plans to distribute content through three platforms, which include cable television; hotel in-room channel; and www.Zonzia.com Website.

Upon the full launch of all three of the company’s delivery platforms, the company plans to deliver various content, including

Original programming – featuring TV series, mini-series, and documentaries;

Feature films – full-length feature films from major Hollywood studios and independent production companies;

Television Shows – TV series from major networks and independent production companies; and 

Concerts, Sports and Live Events – streaming live music concerts, live sports events and other live events.

Zonzia (Over-The-Top (OTT)) Channel

The company plans to make its content readily available on computers, tablets, mobile devices and other Internet connected devices. Its content would be posted on www.zonzia.com. OTT refers to any content not delivered as specifically programmed linear channels from a pay TV operator, which might encompass even on-demand content provided as TV Everywhere by a pay TV operator.

The company anticipates that its video on demand (VOD) and subscription video on demand offerings would include full length feature films, TV series, documentaries, live events and general programming. The company is cross-soliciting film, TV and live event promoters, offering them various deal options which would allow them to have direct access to its targeted demographics, including charging them up-front production fees and entering into revenue sharing deals.

Advertising

The company intends to use advertising as a means of generating revenue by engaging users on all of its platforms, including its Website, www.zonzia.com, mobile applications, and VOD and other channel offerings.

The company’s advertising options, which would be specifically co-designed by its sales and marketing team, would allow its customers to create targeted ads to appear beside related search results or Web content on its Websites and include the following:

Display Advertising – This includes banner ads and consists of text and graphics based ads that appear next to content relevant to the various product offerings. The company would offer these banner ads in various sizes, allowing for each to contain logos, pictures, other graphics and video;

Display Advertorials – Display advertorials are advertisements in the form of editorial content and designed to provide consumers additional insights to the company’s customers’ products or services. Advertorials are generally limited to 500 words and might be created by its content development team or might be provided directly by the customer or the customer’s representative;

Native Advertising – Native advertising programs are designed to specifically match content and advertising directed at smaller, targeted groups of users based on specific interests; and

Video Advertising – Similar to television commercials widely seen on network TV, video advertisements would run throughout some of the company’s streaming video offerings.

Intellectual Propertya

As of December 31, 2015, the company has filed trademark applications with the United States Patent and Trademark Office for ZONZIAKIDZ, ZONZIA, Zonzia, ON (stylized), and On (stylized).

Strategy

The company’s overall strategy is to provide, together with its business partners, a mix of established video libraries, consisting of well-known movies, television shows, historical sporting events, documentaries and docu-movies; and original productions and co-productions, which would be contingent upon acquiring adequate funding.

History

Zonzia Media, Inc. was founded in 2014. The company was formerly known as HDIMAX MEDIA, Inc. and changed its name to Zonzia Media, Inc. in March 2015.

records.Short Business Description: ZoomInfo Technologies Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides go-to-market intelligence and engagement platform for sales, marketing, operations, and recruiting professionals in the United States and internationally.
records.Long Business Description:
ZoomInfo Technologies Inc. (ZoomInfo) provides go-to-market software, data, and intelligence for sales, marketing, operations, and recruiting teams.

The company’s go-to-market intelligence platform empowers businesses with AI-ready insights, trusted data, agent-assisted selling and advanced automation providing sales, marketing, operations, and recruiting professionals accurate information and insights on the organizations and professionals they target. This enables the company’s customers to shorten sales cycles and increase win rates by empowering sellers, marketers, and recruiters to efficiently deliver the right message to the right person at the right time in the right way.

ZoomInfo is the modern go-to-market intelligence platform, consisting of three distinct layers that build upon each other:

The company's Intelligence Layer is the foundation of its data-driven strategy. Its best-in-class data, curated through first- and third-party sources, includes billions of data points about companies and contacts, such as intent, hierarchy, location, and financial information.

The company's Orchestration Layer integrates and enriches its data sources. At this stage, its products assign and route data, leads, and insights to the appropriate people. This creates a dataset that is continuously updated and can be used to power automated business workflows. The company's services connect with major CRM system providers, enabling sales operations professionals to access a suite of products, services, and solutions to ingest, match, enrich, and connect data feeds into multiple systems.

The company's Engagement Layer allows sales, marketing, operations, and recruiting professionals to put data-driven insights into action to identify and communicate with prospects and customers. Go-to-market professionals use its engagement layer for multi-touch and multi-channel sales engagement, web meeting recording, transcription, insight generation, and coaching. Marketers drive awareness, lead generation, and deal acceleration campaigns through account-based marketing, advertising, and onsite conversion optimization solutions, including chat functionality. Recruiters and talent acquisition professionals can locate and reach better-suited candidates, use pipeline management tools to collaborate and organize the hiring process, and automate aspects of the candidate outreach process by more efficiently finding and engaging candidates.

The company is able to deliver high-quality intelligence at scale by leveraging an artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) powered engine that gathers billions of data points about companies and contact information from millions of sources and standardizes, matches to entities, verifies, cleans, and applies the processed data to companies and people. This data engine, along with its team of research analysts and data scientists, enriches its platform by providing deep insights. Its customers access insights directly in the platform and can also integrate its data and insights directly into their CRM system or sales and marketing automation systems, to improve their existing go-to-market processes.

Platform

The company's modern, cloud-based operating system for revenue professionals delivers comprehensive and high-quality intelligence and analytics to provide sales, marketing, operations, and recruiting professionals accurate information and insights on the organizations and professionals they target.

The company enhances the breadth of this intelligence with deep insights, such as personnel moves, pain points, or planned investments, technologies used by companies, intent signals, decision-maker contact information, advanced attributes (such as time series growth, granular department and location information, and employee trends), organizational charts, news and events, hierarchy information, locations, and funding details. All of this can be integrated directly into its customers’ CRM and sales and marketing automation systems.

This 360-degree view of key business insights provides its users with a detailed understanding of their customers and prospects, and coupled with its analytics, shortens sales cycles and increases win rates by enabling sellers, marketers, and recruiters to deliver the right message, to the right person, at the right time, in the right way. The company's intelligence is kept up-to-date in real time. This is accomplished through a combination of robust systems and processes leveraging AI, ML, and its proprietary human-in-the-loop approach.

Data Engine

The company delivers high-quality intelligence at scale by leveraging an AI and ML-powered engine that gathers data from millions of sources and standardizes, matches to entities, verifies, cleans, and applies the processed data to companies and people. It aggregates and extracts distinct types of data, such as revenue, locations, technologies, keywords, contact information, including email addresses, titles, and phone numbers, and many others, from millions of public and proprietary sources. Its evidence-based ML algorithm scores, ranks, and makes determinations about these billions of data points each week. To help train its AI and ML technologies and augment its contributory network, the company has a team of research analysts and data scientists with deep expertise in cleaning business-to-business data. This human-in-the-loop team plays a strategic role, focusing on quality assurance and addressing data and intelligence gaps that technology alone cannot solve. The company has processes in place to use its research team to tag anomalies in data, review data pieces that require additional manual verification, identify patterns to transform this understanding into algorithms, and identify methods to automate data gathering. The company is able to provide a contractual guarantee of the accuracy of certain data points as a result of its focus on quality.

Customers

The company's large and diversified customer base spans a wide variety of industry verticals, including software, business services, manufacturing, telecommunications, financial services, media and internet, transportation, education, hospitality, insurance, and real estate. Its customers range from the largest global enterprises to mid-market companies, and down to small businesses.

The company sells access to its platform to both new and existing customers. It prices its subscriptions based on the functionality, users, and records under management that are included in each product edition. Its core paid products are ZoomInfo Copilot, ZoomInfo Sales, ZoomInfo Marketing, ZoomInfo Operations, and ZoomInfo Talent (with add-on options for some products), and it has a free community edition, ZoomInfo Lite.

Intellectual Property

The company owns a number of patents, registered trademarks (including ZOOMINFO and DISCOVERORG, among others), and copyrights in the United States. It also has a portfolio of registered domain names (including zoominfo.com) for websites that it uses in its business.

Research and Development

The company’s research and development for the year ended December 31, 2025, included $182.0 million.

History

ZoomInfo Technologies Inc. was founded in 2007. The company was incorporated in 2019 as a Delaware corporation.
